/'dar bas longs sku'i yon tan no/ /mas ni chos sku dngos su ston/ /'di yi yan lag bcu gnyis la/ /gseng zhing 'dril ba gnad yin no/ /tshe nyid spel na bug pa bsten/ /thig le lus dang sems kyis bya/ /zhes so/ /de yang ro ma ni rkyang ma'i g.yon nas 'khril nas g.yas su rgyu la/ rkyang ma ni snying gi rtse mo'i g.yon nas 'thon te mgrin pa rtsa'i dra ba las 'thon nas thod pa'i nang na tshur zhugs te mig g.yon pa na sgo dod pa'o/ /ro ma ni mig g.yas pa'o/ /kun 'dar ma ni dbus drang por gnas te rtse mo gsum du gyes nas sgo dbus ma spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga la snang bar byed la/ de nas rig pa rtog pa med pa'i sku 'char ro/ /mu tig phreng ba las/ rig pa rtog med lu gu rgyud/ /bde chen tshangs pa'i sgo nas snang*/ /zhes so/ /rtse mo g.yas pa rna ba g.yas pa la snang bas las kyi rlung 'gyu ste/ 'di la yal ga phra mo gnyis sna bug gnyis la zug pas las rlung byed pa dang bcas pa 'gyu ba'o/ /rna ba g.yon pa la zug pa de nas ye shes kyi rlung 'char bar byed pa'o/ /thal 'gyur las/ rna ba g.yas pas las rlung ston/ /g.yon pas sgra nyams ye shes nyid/ /ces so/ /g.yon rtsa na rang bzhin gyi thig le g.yas na kun rdzob kyi thig le'o/ /de yang g.yas pa kun rdzob kyi thig le la brten nas lus smin par byed la/ de nyid kyis lus bde ba dang sdug bsngal ba dang btang snyoms dang 'byung ba 'phel ba dang nyams pa la sogs pa'i las byed do/ /de yang de nyid la mdud pa phra mo bzhi yod de lte ba dang*/ dran pa dang ro rnams dang rtse mo bzhin dang po rgyus skyed byed kyi rtsa bskyed pas rtsa'i nang du pha'i rgyu thig le dkar po yungs 'bru la bcur bgos pa'i cha tsam zhig gnas so/ /de la brten nas lus yar 'phel du bskyed pas rgyu zhes bya'o/ /dran pa na ma'i rgyu thig le dmar po yungs 'bru'i bcu cha tsam gnas pas dran bsam sna tshogs pa 'gyu ba'i rten du gnas pas dran pa zhes bya'o/

/de nas ro rnams na rlung gi thig le yungs 'bru'i bcu cha tsam du gnas te des ni dngas snyigs 'byed par byed de/ snyigs mas dri chen dang dri chu la sogs phyir 'dor bar byed la/ dngas mas lus kyi bkrag dang gzi mdangs skyed par byed pas na ro rnams zhes bya'o/ /rtse mo na sems kyi rang bzhin 'od kyi thig le yungs 'bru'i bcu cha tsam du gnas pas na rtse mo zhes bya'o/ /de dag ni kun rdzob kyi rten zhes bya'o/ /de dag 'phos pa na lus sems gnyis 'bral bar 'gyur ro/ /de la kun rdzob kyi rgyu de las khrag tu smin la/ khrag las sha sha las chu ba/ chu ba las chu ser/ chu ser las tshil/ tshil las rkang*/ rkang las rkang mar/ rkang mar las rgyungs pa/ de las kun rdzob kyi thig ler smin pa'o/ /rkyang ma'i mdud pa bzhi ni/ skyed byed na rgyang zhags chu'i sgron ma'i sa bon thig le rab tu chung ba gnyis gnas/ dran pa na shes rab rang byung gi sgron ma'i rten me'i thig le rab tu 'phro bar gnas so/ /ro rnams na dbyings rnam par dag pa'i rten 'od lnga'i thig le yungs 'bru tsam mu khyud dang bcas par gnas so/ /rtse mo na thig le stong pa'i rten 'od kyi thig le so so'i tshon gang du gnas so/ /de la brten nas zag pa med pa'i ye shes mngon du 'char ro/ /de nyid la brten nas rang bzhin du 'tshang rgya'o/ /des na rang bzhin gyi thig le zhes bya ste sgo dag pa las sgron ma bzhi dang ma dag pa las 'byung ba bzhir 'gyur la/ dbus ma kun 'dar ma ni rtsa thams cad kyi rang bzhin 'dus pa ste/ de yang rlung gi 'phen sdud kyis 'dar zhing 'khor 'das kyi gzhir byung bas ma zhes bya la/ de nas don dam par chos nyid kyi thig le 'gyu ste/ 'di'i mdud pa bzhin skyed byed na sku thams cad kyi rten yungs 'bru tsam la 'od kyi zhal phyag tu gsal bar gnas so/ /dran pa na ye shes kyi rten gzhal yas khang sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang lha so so'i sku mdog dang phyag mtshan du gsal ba yungs 'bru tsam la rang gang la babs pa'i lha'i dkyil 'khor la rdzogs par gnas

so/ /'di'i gnad me tog phog pa'i dkyil 'khor gyis mtshon pas rang gi rigs nges par sgrub pa yin no/ /rtse mo na 'od thams cad kyi rten khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gnas so/ /de yang dbus ma nas khrag dang chu ser med par stong pa zang thal bas rlung gi las/ g.yas nas chu dang khrag dang byang sems rgyu bas thig le'i las/ g.yon nas 'byung ba'i dngas ma dang ye shes rgyu bas rtsa rang gi las so/ /

gsum pa 'od rtsa ye shes kyi rten ni snying ga'i 'od gsal las sgo bzhir gyes pas rtsa bzhi ste/ ka ti gser gyi rtsa chen nas 'od gsal gyi snang ba 'byung ba'i rten byed/ dar dkar snal ma nas phyir yul la 'jug pa'i rten byed/ phra la 'khril nas rang 'char ba'i rten byed/ shel bug can nas rang snang ba'i rten byed do/ /stong pa rang grol ni tshangs bug la zug pa ste lu gu rgyud sku'i rten byed pa dang bsdoms na nang rtsa lnga ste ye shes lnga'i 'od yin la/ rang bzhin du bzhir byed pas sgron ma bzhi 'phel ston pa ni/ sgron ma 'bar ba las/ sems can kun gyi lus kyi dkyil/ /tsitta rin chen gzhal yas las/ /rtsa ni stong phrag grangs mang yang*/ /khyad par chen po'i rtsa bzhi las/ /ka ti gser gyi rtsa chen dang*/ /dar dkar snal ma lta bu dang*/ /phra la 'khril dang shel bug can/ /'di bzhi'i nang du khyad par du/ /gnas shing rlung gi rta la zhon/ / 'byung dang 'jug dang rang shar dang*/ /snang ba yi ni bdag nyid du/ /zhes so/ /'od rtsa 'di dag la don dam pa ye shes chen po'i rtsa zhes bshad do/ / don gsum pa thig le'i bkod tshul bye brag tu bstan pa la gsum ste/ dbyings spyir bstan/ gnas pa bye brag tu bshad/ 'od gsal dag pa'i thig les mjug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni spyir rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi'i nang thams cad na 'od dang zer gyis khyab la/ khyad par du ro ma na kun rdzob rgyu'i thig le thabs kyi rang bzhin zag bcas bde ba'i rang bzhin dang*/ rkyang ma na don dam ye shes kyi thig le shes rab zag pa med pa bde ba'i rang bzhin dang*/ kun 'dar ma na rang bzhin chos nyid kyi thig le 'od gsal lhun gyis grub pa de'i rang bzhin dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa ste/ mu tig phreng ba las/ rtsa rnams nang na thig le ste/ /phra dang 'khyug pa'i bdag nyid can/ / 'od zer nyid kyis mdzes pa'o/ /de yang cha ni gsum pa ste/

/g.yas dang g.yon dang dbus ma'o/ /g.yas pa kun rdzob thig le ste/ /bde ba chen po'i yan lag can/ /bde ba 'dus pa'i 'byung gnas ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang chen yin/ /thabs kyi mtshon pa'i rang bzhin no/ /don dam chos sku'i rang bzhin can/ /stong gsal thig le gcig tu gnas/ /dbus na gnas shing rang bzhin gsal/ /spro bsdu smra bsam yul las 'das/ /bag chags rnam par rtog pa bral/ /yod med mtha' gnyis rnam par bsal/ /rtag chad mu la gnas pa med/ /rnam par rtog med lhun gyis grub/ /brjod pa med cing ngang gis stong*/ /don dam dngos po'i thig le'o/ /g.yon pa rang bzhin thig le gnas/ /bde ba zung 'jug gnyis khyab ste/ /rab tu gnas pa ma yin par/ kha sbyor nyid kyi bde ba thob/ /phyag rgya chen po nyid kyi rgyu/ /bde chen ye shes chen po'i lam/ /gsang sngags kun bdag dkyil 'khor yin/ /'khor ba bskyod pa'i thabs chen po/ /gsang ba'i ye gdangs 'bar ba'i 'od/ /de ni bde chen ngo bo'o/ /zhes so/ / gnyis pa gnas bye brag tu bshad pa ni/ rang shar las/ sems can kun gyi tsitta na/ /rnam dag sku yi thig le gnas/ /sems can kun gyi dhū tī na/ /stong nyid rtags kyi thig le gnas/ /sems can kun gyi shel dkar na/ /stong gsal 'bar ba'i thig le gnas/ /sems can kun gyi dar dkar na/ /lam gyi thig le bzang po gnas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi stong lam na/ / 'od gsal gnyis med thig le gnas/ /sems can kun gyi yul nyid na/ /sna tshogs 'char ba'i thig le gnas/ /de bzhin sems can thams cad la/ /dbyer med tshul gyis gnas pa yin/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa 'od gsal dag pa'i thig les mjug bsdu ba ni/ 'od rtsa bzhi nas rgyu ba'i thig le ste ka ti gser gyi rtsa chen na gzhi'i thig le bzang po ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum gyi bdag nyid snying ga la brten nas gnas so/ /dar dkar snal ma na lam gyi thig le bzang po sgron ma bzhi dang bcas pa chu'i sgron ma ste g.yas na'o/

/phra la 'khril na bzang po'i rtse mo'i thig le nyams gong 'phel gyi snang ba sna tshogs pa g.yon na'o/ /shel bug can na tshad phebs kyi snang ba'i rten nang gsal ye shes kyi 'char gzhir gnas so/ /stong pa rang grol na rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyi sku gnas pa ste/ sgron ma 'bar ba las/ gzhi yi thig le bzang po dang*/ /lam gyi thig le de bzhin bzang*/ /bzang po rnams kyi rtse mo dang*/ / bzang po'i rgyan dang ldan par yang*/ /rtsa rnams kyi ni nang na gnas/ /zhes so/ /de yang kun rdzob rgyu'i thig le la brten nas/ thun mong gi dngos grub phran tshegs dang sems gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin lam du byed la/ don dam 'od gsal gyi thig le la brten nas mchog gi dngos grub chos sku dang ye shes rang babs kyi bsam gtan mngon du byed par bstan te/ de la rdzogs pa chen po 'di'i lugs kyi kun rdzob kyi thig le lam gyi ngo bo ma yin pas don dam gyi thig le la brten nas 'od gsal bsgom pa yin la/ kha cig 'dir 'jug pa'i skal ba ni yod/ kun rdzob kyi thig le la zhen che ba dag 'jug pa'i cha tsam du skal chad rjes su 'dzin pa'i thabs kyi bye brag tsam du kun rdzob kyi thig le bsgom pa'i thabs dang rig ma bsten pa la sogs pa gsungs la/ phyis don dam gyi thig le la 'jug pa'i rim pa gsungs te/ de'i rim pa ni/ thal 'gyur las/ thig le chos nyid bsten 'dod pas/ /don dam dang ni kun rdzob las/ /re zhig kun rdzob thig le la/ /brten nas sangs rgyas 'dod pa yis/ /rig ma mtshan nyid rdzogs pa ni/ /lha dang lha min tshangs pa dang*/ / gal te rigs ngan mu stegs sam/ /mtshan nyid rdzogs pa dag mthong na/ / 'gugs pa'i sbyor ba nges brtsams nas/ /bsten bya nyid dang rtsa rnams dang*/ /dmigs bya dag gis lus rdzogs bya/ /de nas kun rdzob thig le nyid/ /dbab cing gzung dang bzlog pa dang*/ /rtsa la dgram zhing rlung la

bsre/ /stong nyid bsten bya blo rjes bcad (1) / /lus dang sems gnyis go bzlog bya/ /don dam thig le brten pa yis/ /chos sku stong pa'i yul rnams rnyed/ /thig le stong pa'i sgron ma nyid/ /ltems te rig pa'i rtsal rnams sbyang*/ /nyin mtshan med par goms spyod na/ /'di nyid rtsol bral mngon du snang*/ /de ni 'byongs pa'i tshad yin no/ /zhes so/ /de ltar na gnyis las/ kun rdzob ni lam 'dir 'jug pa'i thabs yid ches su 'jug pa tsam las lam dngos ma yin pas 'dir de nyams su len lugs rnams btang snyoms su gzhag go /don dam gyi thig le 'di lam dngos yin pas rgyas par ston te/ khyad par du sgron ma ltems pa yul gyi skabs su ston pas der rtogs par bya'o/ /'di chings gal po che yin te deng sang kha cig kun rdzob dang don dam gyi thig le gnyis ka 'di'i lam du 'dod la/ khyad par du kun rdzob kyi kha zin byed pa ni 'di'i phyogs ma mthong ba yin te/ kun rdzob la sbyong byed lus kyi 'khrul 'khor dmigs pa'i chings la sogs pa rtsol bcas du ma dang*/ sbyangs 'bras rags pa'i lus la ting nge 'dzin bde stong du 'dod la/ 'dir go bzlog ste lus lta stangs las mi g.yo ba la sogs pa gsum dang 'od lus 'dod pa khyad par che'o/ /tshig don rin po che'i mdzod las ye shes kyi lam bstan pa ste rdo rje'i gnas lnga pa rgya cher bshad pa'o// // de nas ye shes 'char ba'i sgo gtan la dbab pa la don gnyis te/ sgo dngos ngos gzung ba dang*/ de las 'char ba sgron ma bzhi'i gnas rgya cher bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ ye shes kyi snang ba phyir gsal du 'char ba'i sgo dngos ni mig gnyis te/ de yang 'byung ba bzhi'i dngas ma lte ba'i rtsa mdud du spyan gnyis chags pa la rtsa gsum gyis sprel (1) te lte ba nas snying gar 'brel/ de nas mgrin par 'brel/ de nas klad pa dung khang du g.yas su 'khyil ba'i rtsa bzhi las dbang po'i yul 'char bar byed pa'i rtsa rtsa ba gcig la rtse mo lngar gyes nas sgo lnga so so'i rten byed pa las/

khyad par gzugs mthong ba'i rten byed pa'i rtsa skyon yon dbang po dngas byed ces bya ba rtse che la rtsa ba phra ba ba men gyi rwa lta bu'i rtsa gnyis mig gnyis kyi a 'bras kyi dngas ma la zug pa la brten nas gzugs snang mthong ba la mthong cha gnyis te/ ma dag pa 'khor ba'i cha 'khrul snang sa rdo ri brag la sogs pa mthong ba dang*/ dag pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i cha stong gzugs 'od gsal gyi snang ba mthong bas na/ gnyis kyi cha 'dzin 'khor 'das ston/ /zhes bya'o/ /mthong cha gnyis la'ang zhib tu phye na 'od rtsa'i cha des 'od snang mthong bas rgyang zhags dag pa chu'i sgron ma zhes bya la/ dbang po rten gyi cha des 'khrul snang mthong bas rgyang zhags ma dag pa chu'i sgron ma zhes bya bar gnas so/ / rang bzhin du de gnyis bsdoms pa la rgyang zhags chu'i sgron ma zhes gcig tu bzhag kyang cha gnyis su gnas la/ shin tu btags na 'od rtsa dngas pa'i sna de nyid rgyang zhags chu'i sgron ma yin gyi 'khrul snang mthong ba de ma yin te/ lam snang mthong byed ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ / 'di la gnad che bar yod pas rtog dpyod zhib tu thong mdzod/ snga rabs pa dag mig dngos la 'dod kyang 'od rtsa'i cha zug pa de ma phyed par snang ngo*/ / de ltar na dar dkar dang phra la 'khril gyi rtsa sna rgyang zhags chu'i sgron ma las thig le stong pa'i sgron ma yi ge na ro lta bu dang*/ spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga na rdo rje lu gu rgyud rtog pa med pa'i sku dang*/ de dag gi rtsal shes rab rang byung gi sgron ma shes rab kyi rang rtsal du ma dang 'od rtsa'i gdangs lu gu rgyud kyi snang ba gser gyi skud pa lta bur 'char ro/ /de skad du'ang thal 'gyur las/ ye shes 'char ba'i sgo nyid ni/ /lus bcud dngas ma kun 'dus pa'i/ tsakṣu zhes pa'i sgo nas 'thon/ /gnyis kyi cha 'dzin snang ba mthong*/ /bskyed cing rtsa 'brel 'byung ba'o/ /rtse mo las ni gcig gyur pas/

/dbang po'i yul la 'char byed pa'i/ /gcig la yal ga lnga yod pa/ /so so'i dbang po'i sgo la snang*/ /khyad par skyon yon dngas 'byed pa/ /ba men rwa 'dra 'khyil ba las/ /a 'bras zhes pa dkar nag phyed/ /rig cing gzugs rnams 'dzin pa dang*/ /shes pa'i rang rtsal rdzogs par ston/ /'di las ye shes dngos 'byung ste/ /mngon gsum pa dang rang gnad kyi/ /chos nyid dag pa'i rang snang yul/ /rtog bcas 'gag par gnas pa'o/ /de yi 'byung byed ci zhe na/ /don dam chos nyid 'byung ba las/ /sgron ma rnam pa bzhi zhes te/ /smin cing 'jug la khyab stong pas/ /chos nyid rang snang sdud pa'o/ /zhes pa dang*/ sgron ma 'bar ba las/ klad pa dung khang dkar po nas/ /g.yas su 'khyil ba gsum yod pa'i/ /rtsa ni ba men rwa yi dbyibs/ /dbang po'i dngas ma kun 'dus nas/ /dbang po'i yul la 'char byed pa'i/ /rtsa yi nang na 'di nyid gnas/ /thog ma rang gi lus bskyed pa'i/ /ma yi mngal du zhugs pa'i tshe/ /lus kun gyi ni dngas ma ru/ / lte ba'i rtsa mdud chen po las/ /dbus kyi gru gsum nyid du yang*/ /pha ma'i rgyu rkyen dngas ma las/ / mig gi 'bras bu nyid du chags/ /de yang pha ma'i cha nyid las/ /dkar nag 'dres pa nyid du'o/ /'char ba'i sgo ni mig gnyis dang*/ / zhes so/ / don gnyis pa de las 'char ba sgron ma bzhi'i gnas rgya cher bshad pa la gnyis te/ 'char gzhi sgron ma bzhi mig gnyis las ji ltar 'char ba'i 'brel dgod pas ngo bo mdor bstan pa dang*/ 'char byed sgron ma dngos so sor bstan pas rang bzhin rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mig g.yas nas rgyang zhags chu'i sgron ma dang shes rab rang byung gi sgron ma gnyis te ji snyed mkhyen pa'i ye shes thabs snang ba'i rang bzhin du 'char la/ mig g.yon nas thig le stong pa'i sgron ma dang dbyings rnam dag gi sgron ma gnyis ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i ye shes shes rab stong pa'i rang bzhin du 'char zhing*/

de'i dbus tshangs pa'i bu ga nas rig pa rtog med kyi sku lu gu rgyud thig le brtsegs mar snang ba ste/ mu tig phreng ba las/ 'gro ba'i lam ni mthong byed sgo/ /de nyid g.yas gnyis g.yon gnyis dbus/ /sgron ma 'bar ba'i tshul du gnas/ / thig le stong pa'i sgron ma dang*/ /dag pa dbyings kyi sgron ma dang*/ /shes rab rang byung nyid dang ni/ /rgyang zhags chu yi sgron ma ni/ /mthong byed yul la snang ba'o/ /rig pa rtog med lu gu rgyud/ /bde chen tshangs pa'i sgo nas snang*/ / zhes pa dang*/ thal 'gyur las/ dngas ma 'dus pa'i mig gnyis nas/ / thabs dang shes rab khyad par las/ /ji lta mkhyen pa'i thig le dang*/ /dag pa dbyings kyi sgron mar snang*/ /ji snyed pas ni rgyang zhags dang*/ /shes rab sgron mar smin pa yi/ /'gro ba rnams kyi las dang yang*/ /dbang po'i bye brag ji lta bar/ /de la bslab pas shes par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ / gnyis pa la gnyis te/ rnam dbye spyir bstan pa dang*/ rnam grangs bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ / dang po ni sgron ma bzhi ste/ rang shar las/ sgron ma rnam bzhi 'di lta ste/ /thig le stong pa'i sgron ma dang*/ /rig pa dbyings kyi sgron ma dang*/ /shes rab rang byung sgron ma dang*/ /rgyang zhags chu yi sgron ma rnams/ /sems can kun la snang ba'o/ /zhes pa dang*/ sgron ma 'bar ba las/ 'di kun sgron ma rnam bzhi yis/ /sems can kun gyi snang ba 'dzin/ /rgyang zhags chu yi sgron ma yis/ /gzugs sogs ngo bo nyid kyi sdud/ /shes rab rang byung sgron ma yis/ /theg pa rnams kyi the tshom gcod/ /thig le stong pa'i sgron ma yis/ /'khor 'das bsre ba'i mtshams sbyor byed/ /dag pa dbyings kyi sgron ma yis/ /rnal 'byor nyams kyi sa bon 'debs/ /'di kun khyad par snang ba'o/ /zhes so/ / gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ rgyang zhags chu/ thig le stong pa/ dbyings rnam dag shes rab rang byung gi sgron ma'i rang bzhin rgyas par bshad pa'o/

/dang po la ngo bo/ nges tshig mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ rten/ bzhugs tshul/ gnas/ yul/ dpe/ gnad dang bcu las/ dang po ngo bo ni/ rgyang zhags chu'i sgron ma'i ngo bos snang ba gnyis kyi cha 'dzin pas 'khor 'das mthun par lta ba ste/ sgron ma 'bar ba las/ rgyang zhags chu yi sgron ma yis/ /ngo bo snang ba gnyis ka sdud/ /mthong byed 'dzin cha ma 'gags phyir/ /gnyis ka'i cha 'dzin lta bas na/ /'khor 'das mthun pa'i lta ba'o/ /zhes so/ /nges tshig ni/ mu tig phreng ba las/ rgyang ni sgo lnga'i rta pho la/ /yid kyi rnam shes zhon nas rgyu/ /yul rnams kun la 'jug cing sdud/ /zhags pas bzung ba'i yul nyid ni/ /'dzin pa'i sems kyis rnam par bzung*/ /chus ni dngas snyigs 'byed par byed/ / de yang gnyis na cha mnyam ste/ /mdor na dbang po'i dngas ma yin/ /zhes dang*/ snga ma las/ nges pa'i tshig ni 'di lta bu/ /rgyang ni ring ba'i rgyud 'dzin pas/ /gzugs su snang ba 'dzin pa dang*/ /kha dog la sogs sdud pa dang*/ / rig pa'i sku yang rgyang ring nas/ /mthong byed 'dzin par byed pa dang*/ /'khor ba rtogs pa'i cha nas ni/ /rgyang du 'phen pas rgyang zhes bya/ /de bzhin ma rtogs phyogs nas kyang*/ /myang 'das 'phen pas rgyang yin no/ /de bzhin 'khor ba'i snang cha nas/ /gzugs dang 'dod yon lnga rnams ni/ /'di yis 'ching bas zhags pa yin/ /dbang po'i yul la snang ba yis/ /dran bsam bdag tu 'dis 'dzin pas/ /zhags pa zhes ni rgyang nas 'dzin/ /de bzhin nam mkha' sprin bral la/ /rig pa bdag med skur snang ba/ /snang ba yengs su mi 'jug par/ /'di yis 'dzin pas zhags zhes bya/ /chu ni snang ba de dag la/ /zhen pa rang sar log nas ni/ /kun la chags pa'i sems med

par/ /snang ba rang sar bzhag pas ni/ /bdag 'dzin bral bas chu zhes bya/ /sgron ni rang gi snang ba kun/ /gong nas gong du 'phel ba yi/ /rig pa'i ye shes gsal bas sgron/ /'byung ba rags pa'i snang ba kun/ /rang shes spyod pa 'gag med cing*/ /dbang po'i rang sgor gsal bas sgron/ /rig pa phyi yi dbyings bzhag pas/ /nang dbyings rang sar dag ste snang*/ /nyams kyi snang ba 'dis bskyed pas/ /dbyings rig 'dres pas ma yang yin/ /dbang po kun gyi dngas ma yi/ /'char byed sgo ni mig yin pas/ kun gyi gzhi 'dzin ma zhes bya/ /zhes so/ /mtshan nyid ni/ gzugs snang 'dzin rung du skyes pa gang zhig ye shes kyi snang ba mthong bas 'khrul snang 'gags byed du gnas pa ste/ thal 'gyur las/ rgyang zhags sgron ma'i mtshan nyid ni/ /khyab pas 'jug la 'jug pas khyab/ /'byung ba bzhi dag byed par gnas/ /'dzin 'jug mched dang byed pa'o/ /zhes dang*/ sgron ma 'bar ba las/ 'di yi mtshan nyid 'di lta bu/ /'char byed 'gag pa med pa yi/ /dbang po'i dngas ma mig gi sgor/ / bskyed pas pad ma'i spyan du gnas/ /rang gi mtshan nyid dbang po 'dzin/ / 'byung ba las ni 'phen pa dang*/ /sdud dang 'dzin dang mched par snang*/ /ye shes las ni lta ba dang*/ /gnas dang gong ma 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang pos yul dang yul can dang*/ /yul med rnams ni rang 'dzin pa'o/ /zhes so/ /dbye na gsum ste/ 'byung ba'i dngas ma 'dus pa'i rgyang zhags dbang rten dngas pa zar ma'i me tog lta bu dang*/ dbang po 'dus pa'i rgyang zhags dbang po gzugs can pa gzugs la 'dzin nus su skyes pa mig gi dbang po dang*/ ye shes 'dus pa'i rgyang zhags 'od rtsa dngas pa'i rtsa sna 'od gsal gyi snang ba mthong byed du gnas pa ste/ de nyid las/ dbye ba rnam pa gsum yin no/ / 'byung ba'i dngas ma rang 'dus pa'i/ /rgyang zhags chu yi sgron ma dang*/ /ye shes 'dus pa'i rgyang zhags dang*/ /dbang po 'dus pa'i rgyang zhags so/

/ zhes so/ /rten ni rang gnas mig la brten la mthong byed kyi cha de snang yul de la brten pas dag ma dag gnyis la brten pa ste/ thal 'gyur las/ rgyang zhags rten ni snang ba la/ /dag dang ma dag bye brag gis/ /las dang tshogs pa dag dang ni/ /sku dang ye shes nyid la brten/ /zhes so/ /bzhugs tshul ni snang ba 'dzin byed du rang gsal 'gag med chen por bzhugs te/ sgron ma 'bar ba las/ gnas dang gong ma 'dzin par bzhugs/ /zhes so/ /gnas ni de nyid las/ 'di yi gnas ni mig yin te/ /mthong byed 'gag pa med pa yis/ /yul rnams 'dzin par byed pa yin/ /zhes so/ /yul ni snang yul 'khrul pa de'i don rang mtshan gyi cha ste dngas ma 'dus pa'i yul lo/ /de la gzugs zhes ming gi cha de dbang po'i rgyang zhags kyi yul lo/ /'od snang stong gzugs ni ye shes kyi rgyang zhags kyi yul te/ de nyid la bslab par bya ba ni/ thal 'gyur las/ rgyang zhags yul ni gzugs la sogs/ /sdud cing 'dzin la 'phen par byed/ /gnad kyis bcings dang zhags pa dang*/ /dbang po sgyur dang rtsa ba bcad/ /'dren cing gzugs la bslab par bya/ /zhes so/ /mtshon dpe ni lcags kyu lta bu ste/ mu tig phreng ba las/ dper na 'dzin byed lcags kyu ltar/ /zhes pa dang*/ sgron ma 'bar ba las/ dper na 'dzin byed lcags kyu yis/ /gang snang sna nas 'dzin pa bzhin/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi/ /sna gnyis 'di yis 'dzin par byed/ /ces so/ /ji ltar nyams su len pa'i gnad ni/ spyir snang yul gtad dus rig pa dal ba rlung dal ba yul mi rtog pa gsum yin la/ 'dir mig mi 'gul ba gtso bas lta stangs dang sbyar ba ste/ thal 'gyur las/ sgron ma'i gnad ni ngas bshad kyi/ /lha bu skal ldan khyod nyon cig /yul dang rig pa rlung dag gis/ /chos nyid lam du gzung ba'i phyir/ /ye shes rdzogs pas chos nyid dag /'di yang sgron ma'i gnad yin no/ /rgyang zhags 'gul ba med pa gnad/

/'di dus lta stangs gsum dang sbyar/ /zhes so/ / gnyis pa thig le stong pa'i sgron ma rgyas par bshad pa la'ang*/ ngo bo/ nges tshig mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ rten/ gnas/ yul/ sgo/ rang bzhin/ tshad/ dngos/ dpe/ gnad dang bcu gsum las/ ngo bo ni rang gsal ka dag stong pa'i rang gdangs su gnas te/ sgron ma 'bar ba las/ thig le stong pa'i sgron ma ni/ /chos rnams kun gyi yid ches pas/ /'di nyid su yis shes pa de/ / thig le'i sku la longs spyod de/ /goms pa rnams kyi spyod yul thob/ /de phyir de yi ngo bo ni/ /nyag gcig cha phra spros dang bral/ /stong pa'i mu bral rang gsal che/ /rang bzhin rang gsal mnyam pa nyid/ /mi rtog spros bral zlum por gnas/ /ma bskur rang dbang bzhi rdzogs phyir/ /dmar po rang gsal ye nas dngas/ /dri ma med cing ka dag pas/ /bdag 'ching nyon mongs rnams dang bral/ /rang gis rang gsal ngo bo stong*/ /'di ni de yi ngo bor 'dod/ / ces so/ /nges tshig ni/ mu tig phreng ba las/ thig ni 'gyur ba yod ma yin/ /le ni khyab cing yul la snang*/ /stong pa dngos po mtshan ma med/ /sgron mas mun sel snang bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang*/ snga ma de nyid las/ thig ni mi 'gyur drang po la/ /ye nas bcos pa nyid dang bral/ /le ni gdal ba chen po la/ /snang ba rnams ni rang sar rdzogs/ /stong pa dngos po 'dzin pa ni/ /yul la zhen pa'i blo rnams bkag /rang bzhin stong pa chen po yi/ /gsal bar rang zhen blo mi snang*/ /sgron mas 'od lnga snang bar ni/ /byas te rang ngo gsal rig bcas/ /'di rnams nges pa'i tshig yin no/ /zhes so/ /mtshan nyid ni tshon gang 'od kyi thig le gang zhig rang gsal zlum zhing zug rngu dang bral ba ste/ thal 'gyur las/ thig le stong pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /zlum zhing rang bzhin kun gsal ba/ /dmar dngas kha dog gsal ba'i 'od/ /spros dang bcas te mched par byed/ /ces pa dang*/ sgron ma 'bar ba las/ mtshan nyid stong pa gsal bas khyab/

/rang ngo lus kyi mtha' rnams zad/ /ces so/ /dbye ba ni lnga ste/ gzhi gnas rig pa'i thig le stong pa snying ga na gnas/ lus gnas rtsa'i thig le stong pa rtsa rnams na gnas/ kun rdzob rgyu'i thig le ro ma na gnas/ don dam spros med kyi thig le stong pa rkyang ma na gnas/ rang byung 'bras bu'i thig le stong pa mig na gnas pa'o/ /'di dag kyang rang ngo ye nas stong pas thig le stong pa'i khongs su gtogs pa'i phyir dbye ba tsam du zad mod/ don la mig gnyis la ltos nas gnyis su 'gyur ba kho na ste/ sgron ma 'bar ba las/ dbye ba nyid ni rnam pa lnga/ /gzhi gnas rang gi thig le yis/ /snang srid 'khor 'das gcig tu bzlums/ /lus gnas rtsa yi thig le yis/ /bde dang sdug bsngal gcig tu bzlums/ /kun rdzob rgyu yi thig le yis/ /phung sems bskyed pa'i rgyu rkyen te/ /phung po khams sogs gcig tu bzlums/ /don dam spros med thig le yis/ /dbyings dang rig pa gcig tu bzlums/ /rang byung 'bras bu'i thig le yis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa rnams/ /rtsol sgrub bral ba'i dbyings su bzlums/ /zhes so/ /rten ni/ ngo bo 'od rtsa gnyis la brten/ /snang ba ye shes lnga la brten/ /rnam pa thig le gsal ba la brten/ 'gro 'ong rang gnas rlung la brten/ /yul nam mkha' stong pa la brten/ gnas mig gi dbus na brten/ skye mched nges pa mthong byed kyi rnam shes la brten pa ste/ thal 'gyur las/ thig le stong pa'i brten pa ni/ /rnam shes nyid dang bar snang dang*/ /rtsa dang rlung dang thig le dang*/ /ye shes dag la brten pa'o/ /zhes so/ /gnas ni/ ngo bo'i gnas snying ga gdangs kyi gnas mig gnyis te/ sgron ma 'bar ba las/ sems can kun gyi lus kyi dkyil/ /tsitta rin chen gzhal yas las/ /zhes so/ /yul ni/ 'od lngar gsal ba dang*/ de las mched pa'i phyed sku dang*/ sku rkyang dang*/ yab yum dang*/ tshom bu dang*/

dkyil 'khor dang*/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i snang ba drug dang longs sku las sprul sku de las zer gyi sku 'phro bas gsum dang*/ zhi khro gnyis dang*/ thub pa drug gi rnam par yul du snang ba thams cad kyi nam mkha' dag pas gsal ba dang*/ me dag pas dro ba dang*/ chu dag pas bsil ba dang*/ sa dag pas yang ba dang*/ rlung dag pas g.yo ba'i rang bzhin can te/ de yang thal 'gyur las/ thig le'i yul ni kha dog ste/ /lnga dang drug dang gsum gcig drug /gsal dang dro dang bsil ba dang*/ /yang zhing g.yo ba'i bdag nyid 'dzin/ /don dam chos nyid 'byung ba'o/ /zhes pa dang*/ sgron ma 'bar ba las/ rna ba'i yul du gsal bar yang*/ /stong pa nyid las rang log pa'i/ /myong byed gsal ba'i snang bar ni/ /ye gdangs lnga dang bcas par yang*/ /rang bzhin babs kyis gnas pa la/ /gsal byed rnams kyi ngo bor yang*/ /dngos po las ni logs par bzhugs/ /zhes so/ /sgo ni de nyid las/ rkyen gyis ma bsgribs sems can mig /tsakṣu zhes pa'i sgo nas ni/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bzhin du yang*/ /rang gi 'od dang zer nyid du/ /rang chas rnams su rnam par snang*/ /zhes so/ /rang bzhin ni/ ka dag gi rang snang sus kyang ma byas par rang snang ba ste/ de nyid las/ thog ma'i ka dag chen po la/ /rang bzhin nyid ni 'di lta bu/ /sus kyang ma byas rang gsal bar/ /ye nyid nas ni rang bzhin no/ /zhes so/ /tshad ni/ nyams su blangs dus nam mkhar snang la goms pa'i tshad de/ sgron ma 'bar ba las/ thig le spro dang bsdu med par/ /bar snang nyid du sus zin pa/ /de yi tshad du de gyur to/ /zhes so/ / dngos ni/ mig btsir dus snang ba'i 'od dmar ser tshon gang ba de yin te/ de yang 'gro drug so so'i snang tshul ni/ lha la phyir snang du bltar yod pa las 'dod lha rnams la rang mtho gang*/ gzugs khams pa rnams la rang khru gang*/ lha min rnams la rigs gnyis las lha'i rigs can du gtogs pa rnams la 'od zer rab tu gsal ba phyag gang*/

gzhan rnams la phra mo sor bzhi pa mi rnams la mtheb gang*/ dud 'gro rnams la rang gnas tsam las bltar med do/ /yi dgas rnams la rang ngo phra zhing 'phrig pa til 'bru tsam/ dmyal ba rnams la rang gnas rta rnga'am til nyag yang chung tsam ste/ rang shar las/ ma rtogs sems can thams cad la/ /mi la mtshon du yod pa'o/ /lha rnams la ni bltar yod pa'o/ /lha ma yin la phra bar yod/ /byol song rang gnas tsam du yod/ /yi dgas rnams la 'phrig par yod/ /dmyal ba'i yul la til 'bru tsam/ /zhes pa dang*/ sgron ma 'bar ba las/ 'od lnga 'dus pa'i thig le ni/ /lha rnams la ni rang mtho gang*/ /zlum po rang gsal chen por yod/ /lha min rang gi phyag gang ngo*/ /mi rnams rang gi mtheb gang la/ /zlum po zag pa med par yod/ /byol song la ni phyir mi snang*/ /yi dgas rang ngo phra bar yod/ /dmyal ba rnams la rang gsal tsam/ /lha la dkar po shas cher snang*/ /lha min de bzhin ljang gu che/ /mi la dmar gsal rang chags bral/ / byol song nyid la mthing shas che/ /yi dgas ser po de bzhin no/ /dmyal ba rnams la kha dog lnga/ /rang gsal shes pa'i char gnas pa/ /sgron ma dngos ni de bzhin no/ /zhes pa dang*/ seng ge rtsal rdzogs las/ dga' ldan rnams la khru gang gnas/ /rtsod ldan rnams la sor bzhi gnas/ /cha mnyam ldan la tshon gang ngo*/ /nyis ldan rnams la rang gsal tsam/ /bkres ldan rnams la til 'bru tsam*/ /sdug bsngal ldan la rta rnga tsam/ /de bzhin du ni gnas par bshad/ /ces so/ /de bzhin du sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la dpag tu med pa dang byang chub sems dpa' sar gnas la mda' gang dang*/ sprul sku rnams la 'dom gang dang bcas pa'o/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ lha rnam pa gnyis dang bcas pa rnams la rang snang yul la snang la mi la sogs pa lnga la ma bstan na mi mthong ste/ yang de nyid las/ sangs rgyas rnams la dpag tu med/ /byang chub sems dpa' mda' gang

ngo*/ /sbrul pa'i sku la 'dom gang gnas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /sprul ba'i sku dang lha rnams la/ /mngon sum yul la snang ba'o/ /de rnams man chad yul lnga la/ /ma bstan mthong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes so/ /dpe ni mu tig phreng ba las/ dper na rma bya'i mdongs lta bu/ /zhes dang*/ sgron ma 'bar ba las/ dper na rma bya'i mdongs dang mtshungs/ /de bzhin phra ba'i mig dang ni/ /yang na de bzhin nya yi mig /de bzhin srog chags rkun mo'i mig /'di rnams bzhin du gnas pa'o/ /zhes so/ /nyams su len pa'i gnad ni/ thal 'gyur las/ thig le'i sgron ma bltem pa gnad/ /rtsa dang mtheb mdzub ma bral bas/ /ye shes gong du 'phel ba'o/ /zhes pa dang*/ snga ma de nyid las/ rang gi mtheb dang mdzub mo yis/ /tsakṣu'i phug dang 'gram btsir na/ /mngon du snang ste yid ches kyis/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa dbyings rnam par dag pa'i sgron ma rgyas par bshad pa la'ang ngo bo/ nges tshigamatshan nyid/ dbye ba/ rten/ rang bzhin/ yul/ dgos pa/ tshad/ gnas/ sgo/ dngos/ dpe/ gnad dang bcu bzhi las/ ngo bo ni nges pa'i yul byed pa ste/ sgron ma 'bar ba las/ rnam dag dbyings kyi sgron mas ni/ /rig pa yi ni ngo bo sdud/ /lu gu rgyud kyi ra bar snang*/ /'di la sus goms don de nyid/ /mthing ga mi 'gyur rang gsal ba/ /mu khyud kyi ni ra bar gnas/ /rang gsal phyi yi yul du snang*/ /ngo bo nyid ni ma bcos pa'o/ /zhes so/ /nges tshig ni de nyid las/ rnam pa yul du snang ba la/ /dag pa dri ma'i grangs mtha' zad/ /dbyings kyi rig pa'i rang yul byed/ /rdo rje nyid ni lu gu rgyud/ /'di nyid nang du gzhug par bya/ /rang gi ngo bo rtog med du/ /nang gi dbyings kyi go rar yang*/ /ma bzung mi gnas tshul gyis ni/ /'brel (1) ba med par rgyun du snang*/ /sgron gyi rdo rje lu gu rgyud/ /nam mkha' nyid la cer ston te/ /rang bzhin med par snang bar byed/

/mas ni de yi don 'dzin pas/ /rang bzhin nyid kyi nges tshig tu/ /ye nas 'du 'bral med par gnas/ /zhes pa dang*/ mu tig phreng ba las/ dbyings ni yangs shing rgya ma chad/ /chos nyid yul la rnam dag pas/ /gnyis ka'i zur nas 'char bar byed/ khyab chen mthing ga 'gyur ba med/ /snang ba dag pa'i rkyen 'phrad na/ kha dog lnga dang ldan par 'gyur/ / zhes so/ /mtshan nyid ni mthing ga khyab chen dang lnga ldan 'od du snang ba gang zhig rig pa'i yul gyi char gnas pa ste/ thal 'gyur las/ dbyings nyid dag pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /mthing ga rang rdzogs gnyis kyi cha/ /thabs dang shes rab rdzogs pa yi/ /zur gnyis cha las sku gnyis 'dzin/ /rab tu snang ba mched par byed/ /'di dag rnams kyang rang shes rdzogs/ khyab bdag sems dpa'i gzugs brnyan ston/ /lu gu rgyud ni srang nas 'dren/ /dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i gzugs dang mtshungs/ /ye shes rnams kyi gzi mdangs ston/ /'od kyi gting mdangs bkrag kyang ston/ /sku dang thig le 'dun sa'o/ /de ltar ye shes rdzogs pa'i sku/ /'di nyid sus mthong sangs rgyas te/ /sku gsum zad sar rang bzhin grol/ /gzung 'dzin phrang las brgal nas ni/ /'khor 'das rdos thag chod pa'o/ /zhes pa dang*/ sgron ma 'bar ba las/ brjod cing snang tshig gnyis med pas/ /phyi dang nang med dbyings su yang*/ /rang gdal chen po'i ngang du gnas/ /phyi nang med par zang thal

bas/ /ma bsgribs dri ma med par ni/ /ye nas ka dag chen por snang*/ /rnam par dag pa'i dbyings kyi ni/ /mtshan nyid du ni ye nas bzhugs/ /zhes so/ / dbye ba ni gsum ste/ gzhi'i dbyings rang gi snying ga na 'od lnga lhun grub/ lam gyi dbyings mig gi 'od rtsa'i rang 'od snang ba/ yul la snang ba'i dbyings mthing ga dang lnga ldan te/ de nyid las/ dbye na rnam pa gsum yin te/ /gzhi la gnas pa'i dbyings kyis ni/ /rig pa'i ye shes sku ru 'dzin/ /lam la snang ba'i dbyings kyis ni/ /rig pa'i thig le'i dngas ma sdus/ /yul la snang ba'i dbyings kyis ni/ /lu gu rgyud de btson du 'dzin/ /'di kun de yi dbye ba'o/ /zhes so/ /rten ni thal 'gyur las/ rnam dag dbyings kyi rten pa yi/ / smin mtshams nyid dang nam mkha' dang*/ /'od dang thig le dag dang yang*/ / sna tshogs sku la brten pa'o/ /zhes so/ /rang bzhin ni dbyings snang la gtad pas rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin mnyam gnas kyi dbyings chos nyid zad pa'i dgongs pa la ngang gis blo gnas pa ste/ sgron ma 'bar ba las/ rang bzhin snang ba ma 'gags pas/ /blo dngos dran pa kun zad de/ /snang ba rang dag dbyings su ni/ /rtog pa med pa'i rig par yang*/ /mi g.yo mnyam pa nyid shes pas/ /thams cad mnyam pa'i dbyings su yang*/ /ye nas rnam par zad par ni/ /rang bzhin rnam dag dbyings su gnas/ /zhes so/ /yul ni nam mkha' stong pa la 'od lnga rang gsal ba ste/ thal 'gyur las/ dbyings kyi yul ni stong pa dang*/ /gsal dang sgrib bral gdangs 'byin pa/ /khyab cing yangs la gcig 'dus pa'o/ /bag rdul dengs pa'i nam mkha' la/ /mnyam rdzogs chos nyid dag pa'o/ /gsal zhing ye shes lnga yi gdangs/ /'od gsal dag pa'i yul nyid do/ /zhes pa dang*/ snga ma las/ 'di med rig pa'i yul med pas/ /snang ba 'gag pa med pa yi/ /char ni dbyings kyi sgron ma'o/ / zhes so/ /dgongs pa ni snga ma las/

dbyings kyi rig pa'i rang yul byed/ /lu gu rgyud ni srang nas 'dren/ /zhes so/ /tshad ni dbyings smin mtshams las sor bzhi'i yar mtshams su snang dus dang po mthing ga las kha dog lngar mched pa ste/ sgron ma 'bar ba las/ mthing ga mi 'gyur snang ba las/ kha dog gsal ba'i 'od lngar yang*/ /'di nyid rab tu gsal 'gyur zhing*/ /rang gi mdun gyi yar mtshams su/ /sor bzhi 'am ni mtho gang las/ /'phags te lus dang bral ba ni/ /de yi tshad du de 'gyur ro/ /zhes so/ /'di'i dus na 'khor 'das phyed pas phyis 'khor bar mi 'jug pa'i tshad thob ste/ rang byung bstan pa'i rgyud las/ yar mtshams las ni sor bzhi las/ /bral ba'i skyes bu skal bzang ba/ /'khor bar 'jug pa ga la srid/ /ces so/ /gnas ni gsum ste/ phyi'i yul gnas nam mkha'/ bar gyi 'char gnas mig zur/ nang gi gzhi gnas tsitta'o/ /snga ma las/ mig ni 'byung ba'i rkyen med la/ / gnas pa rang gi rig pa nyid/ /lu gu rgyud du snang ba ste/ /sprin bral mkha' la 'dzin par byed/ /rang shes nang du gsal ba'i tshe/ /tsitta'i dkyil du gnas pa yin/ /phyir 'phros sprin bral nam mkha' la'o/ /zhes so/ /sgo ni yang de nyid las/ 'di yi 'char sgo mig nas kyang*/ /'gyur med khyab pa'i tshul du snang*/ /zhes so/ /dngos ni yar mtshams su dang po mthing ga khyab pa chen po'i 'od las rnam lnga rang gsal 'ja' 'od kyi nang na mu khyud kyi ra bas bskor ba'i thig le pad 'dab dang bcas pa ni dbyings kyi ra ba zhes bya ba'am 'ja' 'od kyi dbyings kyi snang ba zhes bya/ mthing ga ni dbyings rang ngo zhes bya ste/ sgron ma 'bar ba las/ mig gi rnam shes dag pa la/ /gsal byed 'bar ba'i 'od zer lnga/ /mi 'gyur khyab pa'i tshul du yang*/ /mthing ga'i rang gdangs chen por gnas/ /'char byed snang ba ma 'gags pas/ /phyi yi yul la rnam par snang*/ /zhes pa dang*/ srid pa yi ni yar mtshams nas/ /'di nyid gnyis 'jug zer

(1) las ni/ /thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin las/ /gnyis ni 'khril te gcig par yang*/ /sor gcig gis ni ma reg par/ /nyin dus 'byung ba'i rkyen ldan pas/ /snang bar 'gyur te mtshan mo yang*/ /mthing ga rang ngo nyid dang 'byar/ /dbyings kyi rang bzhin 'od kyi khyim/ /'gyur med ye gdangs chen por ni/ /sangs rgyas sems can thams cad la/ /sus kyang byas pa med par ni/ /ye nas gnyis med mnyam par gnas/ /'di ni khyab che phra ba las/ /rang gi shes pa'i char shar nas/ /mngon sum nyid de rab tu gsang*/ /gsang ba chen po 'di nyid la/ /gang du spyod par 'dod pa de/ /ye sangs nyid las yang sangs rgyas/ /zhes so/ /dpe ni/ mu tig phreng ba las/ dper na nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon ltar/ /dag pas nyon mongs dri ma zad/ /ces pa dang*/ sgron ma 'bar ba las/ dper na yi ge na ro bzhin/ /gnyis kyi zung ste sdom pas gcig /nag po bsgyur du btub pa min/ /de la goms pa' ི gdeng rnyed nas/ /bar snang 'ja' tshon ji bzhin du/ /kha dog ma 'dres yongs su rdzogs/ /de nas yang ni goms stobs kyis/ /de yi rtags dang ldan pa la/ /bar snang khams kyang de bzhin no/ /zhes so/ /ji ltar nyams su len pa'i gnad ni dang po 'khor 'das ru shan phye bas dbyings snang ngo sprad de sna rtser mig gtad pas 'ja' 'od du snang dus mig zur gnyis la dal bus 'khrid de nam mkhar blta zhing nyi ma'i zur nas khrid pas gang gtad kyi sar snang ba ste/ zla ba dang mar me'i 'od kyi dkyil la gtad pas snang ste rim gyis mched nas 'khrul snang 'od gsal du 'char ba ni goms pa'i tshad kyis mthong ba ste/ sgron ma 'bar ba las/ 'khor 'das ru shan phyed pa ni/ /lus ngag rnams ni rnal du dbab/ /de nas dbyings rig snang ba brtag /'di la goms pa'i tshad rnyed na/ /phyi rol nyid kyi snang ba ni/ /gong nas gong du yang 'phel (1) par/ /rim gyis rang bzhin goms chen thob/ /'di la brtan pa'i tshad rnyed na/

/chos rnams zad sar 'gyur ba ni/ /de nyid goms par bya ba yin/ /yan lag tu ni ngas bshad do/ /zhes pa dang*/ thal 'gyur las/ dbyings kyi gnad ni 'khrid pa ste/ /nyi la bslab thabs rnal 'byor pas/ /legs par sbyar te 'khrid par bya/ /zla ba dag la'ang bslab par bya/ / 'di ltar rgyun du sus byas pa/ /'khrul ba'i snang ba rgyun chad de/ /dag pa ye shes lnga yi 'od/ /sa rdo ri brag bag stongs nas/ /gru chad las ni yul gru tsam/ /'khrid la mkhas pas snang bar 'gyur/ /'di dus thabs kyis bcos pa gnad/ /rdzogs pa'i chos nyid thob pa'o/ /'di ltar goms pas chos nyid stobs/ /lus 'byung rang sor rdzogs pa'o/ /de ltar lus 'byung rgyun chad pas/ /zag bcas phung po mi snang bar/ /'di la mngon par 'tshang rgya'o/ / zhes so/ /bzhi pa shes rab rang byung gi sgron ma rgyas par bshad pa la'ang*/ ngo bo/ nges tshig mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ rten/ sgo/ yul/ gnas/ tshad/ dpe/ gnad dang bcu gcig las/ ngo bo ni/ sgron ma gzhan la khyab byed du yod pa'i shes rab kyi rnam pa ste/ sgron ma 'bar ba las/ shes rab rang byung sgron ma ni/ /'di ltar sgron ma thams cad kyi/ /shes byed tshul du gnas pas na/ /kun gyi cha la 'di nyid pas/ /'byed pa'i shes rab nyid pas ni/ /'byed pa med pa'i tshul du gnas/ /cha phra bskyed pa'i ngo bor ni/ /ye thog nyid nas gnas pa'o/ /zhes so/ /nges tshig ni de nyid las/ shes pa dngos dang dngos med pa'i/ /snang ba kun la rab zhugs nas/ /spyi yi don rnams shes pa dang*/ /ma btsal bzhag pa'i gdeng rnyed de/ /rang gi ye shes tshad rnams shes/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i chos sku ni/ /sus ma rnyed par rang rig pas/ /kun las khyad 'phags rab tu snang*/ /gzhan gyis spyod pa'i gnas med pas/ /rang shar ye nas dag pa'i yul/ /gzhan gyi yul min rang shes bya/ /byis pas 'di don rnyed pa med/ /su la re ba med pa'i phyir/ /ye nas rang snang 'byung zhes bya/

/sgron ni chos nyid thams cad kun/ /gnyis su med par snang bar byed/ /mas ni rang ngo khyab pa'o/ /zhes pa dang*/ mu tig phreng ba las/ shes pas chos rnams cig car rtogs/ /rab ni kun gyi rtse mor gyur/ / rang ni gzhan ltos chos dang bral/ /byung bas ma bkag lhug par snang*/ / g.yon nas 'char byed sgo ma 'gags/ /zhes so/ /mtshan nyid ni spros bral rang byung gi ye shes gang zhig chos can dang chos nyid rang dang spyi'i chos mtshan nyid phyin ci ma log par rtogs pas shes bya shes shing spang bya spong ba ste/ sgron ma 'bar ba las/ snang dang mi snang chos rnams kun/ /rang bzhin med par sus shes pa/ /'di ni de yi mtshan nyid do/ /zhes pa dang*/ thal 'gyur las/ shes rab dag gi mtshan nyid ni/ /mkhas pa tshig 'jug gzhi ma sdud/ /nyon mongs las dang bag chags sreg /smin byed 'khor 'das srog gcod pa'o/ / zhes so/ / dbye ba ni lnga ste/ gzhi gnas rang byung gi shes rab kyis chos thams cad kyi rten byed la/ snang ba cer 'dzin gyi shes rab kyis dbyings rig thad kar rtogs pa/ dran pa 'gag med kyi shes rab kyis mnyam gzhag tu gsal dngas phyed pa/ so sor rtaugs pa'i shes rab kyis spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid shes pa/ 'jug byed rnams gsum gyi shes rab kyis thos bsam sgom pa'i mtshams phyaid pa ste/ snga ma las/ dbye ba rnam pa lnga yin te/ /gzhi gnas rang byung shes rab kyis/ /lus sogs chos kyi rten rnams byed/ /snang ba cer 'dzin shes rab kyis/ /dbyings dang rig pa'i dran pa 'dzin/ /dran pa 'gag med shes rab kyis/ /shes pa rtse gcig yul rnams sdud/ /so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis/ /spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid 'byed/ /'jug byed rnam gsum shes rab kyis/ /rang bzhin bar dor gtan la 'bebs/ /zhes so/ /rten ni snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos dang rang gi mtshan nyid rnams la shes bya dang shes byed du brten la/

rang byung gi ye shes la ldan pa dang*/ ldan chos su ngo bo gcig par brten pa ste/ thal 'gyur las/ shes rab rang byung brten pa ni/ /tshig dang yin min rtog pa dang*/ /grub pa'i mtha' dang lta sgom dang*/ /chos nyid la ni brten pa'o/ /zhes so/ /sgo ni dbang po lnga ste/ sgron ma 'bar ba las/ 'char byed sgo ni dbang po lnga/ khyad par sna nas 'char bar byed/ /de rtags mtshan mo'i dus nyid du/ /glo dang sprid (1) pa drag po dang*/ / shin tu glo drag bus pa'i tshe/ /dmar la dngas pa'i 'od zer ni/ /me stag bzhin du rnam par 'phro/ /de yi tshad dang rtags de yis/ /'char bar byed pa'i sgo ngos zin/ /zhes so/ /shes rab dngos ni shes pas yul rig kyang rtog par ma skyes pa'i gsal ba de la ngos bzung nas sgo dbang po lnga la rtog med kyi shes pa dngas pa lnga 'byung ba la bya'o/ /dbang shes rtog bral de nyid sems yin kyang de'i nang na rang byung ye shes kyi cha gsal rig rtog med gang la'ang mi 'dzin pa zhig yod pa de ngos gzung bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du thos bsam sgom pa'i shes pa'i rang dus na ye shes kyi cha yod pa de 'dir ngos gzung gi rtog dpyod kyi sems kyis bsdus pa la mi 'dod pas gnad 'di gal che bar yod do/ /yul ni rang ngo'i yul rig pa 'jug yul chos dang chos nyid thams cad y-in te/ thal 'gyur las/ shes rab yul ni tshig dang don/ /tshig don 'brel bar 'dod pa yi/ /mtshon pas shes dang brjod pas so/ /mtshon pa dpe dang brda mtshon dang*/ /tshig gis mtshon pa mtha' mar brjod/ /brjod pas shes pa tha snyad dang*/ /ngo sprad pa dang 'khrid pa dang*/ /la bzla shan 'byed dag gis so/ /zhes so/ /gnas ni ngo bo snying ga'i 'od rtsa bzhi dang shes rab kyi rang rtsal zer gdangs kyi ma rtsa thams cad kyi nang na gnas pas lus la khyab ste/ gang du reg kyang shes pas tshor ba des shes la rlung gi rta la zhon pas rang rtsal rtsa 'dab 'gar 'thums dus shes pa rmugs shing mi gsal la rtsa zang thal du rang rtsal tshud dus shes pa gsal la ngar che ba ste/

mdor na ngo bo snying dang rtsal rtsa rnams na rlung gi rta la zhon nas rgyu ste/ sgron ma 'bar ba las/ skyed par byed pa'i rtsa bzhi na/ /'gyu dang 'gul dang 'phrig pa dang*/ / yang zhing bskyod pa'i bdag nyid du/ /tsitta'i dkyil 'khor nyid du 'khor/ / dngas ma shes pa'i bcud rnams ni/ /me stag yar ba'i mtshan nyid du/ /lnga bzhi las kyi rlung dang bcas/ /shes pa gsal gsal rig rig po/ /shes rab rnams kyi rang bzhin du/ /ro ma rkyang ma kun 'dar ma/ /shel bug khog pa stong pa'i nang*/ /gsal ba shes rab chen por bzhugs/ /ming gzhi 'dus pa'i ye gdangs su/ /thams cad 'byed pa'i ngo bor ni/ /ye nas lus kyi cha la gnas/ /skabs su rlung gis rang gzung bas/ /shes pa dran med rmugs par yang*/ /shes rab rtsal rnams rgyas 'thums pas/ /gsal ba'i cha med rmugs par 'gyur/ /rlung gis shes rab rtsal bskyed tshe/ /sngon ma thos pa'i chos rnams kyang*/ /yid la dran zhing gsal bar 'char/ /gsal dang mi gsal rtsal rnams ni/ /rlung gi g.yo 'gul nyid las 'byung*/ /lus dkyil rtsa nang gnas pa'o/ /zhes so/ /tshad ni shes rab lnga po des rang rang gi 'jug yul la zhugs pas gdeng tshad du longs pa'i tshad du phyin pa ni/ yang de nyidalas/ gzhi gnas shes rab rang byung tshad/ /chos kun mnyam pa'i nyams skyes na/ /shes pa brtan pa'i gdeng rnyed yin/ /de nyid 'gyur ba ma yin par/ /rtag tu rgyud la gnas pa na/ /'di ni gzhi gnas shes rab yin/ /'di yis lus kyang yang ba dang*/ /shes pa rnams ni gsal ba'o/ /snang ba cer 'dzin shes rab tshad/ /cog gzhag nyams su myong ba'i rtags/ /lus dkyil kha dog lnga yi 'od/ /rtsol ba med par phyir shar nas/ /'di la shes pa rang sa zin/ /lus kyang sa la reg pa med/ /'di yis shes pa gar gtad pa'i/ /bems po rnams kyang 'gul bar nus/ /rang rtsal 'byongs pa'i tshad yin no/ /dran pa 'gag med shes rab tshad/ /shes pa gzhan la 'jug pa

med/ /gcig pur 'dug par dga' ba dang*/ /dben pa'i sa la rtag tu dad/ /mi dang 'grogs snying mi 'dod par/ /shes pa rtse gcig 'gyur ba med/ /gzhan gyis brjod pa'i gtam la yang*/ /gnyis su 'dzin pa nyid dang bral/ /lta ba mi 'gyur gdeng nyid du/ /nam mkha' dag la 'gro ba snyam/ / sems de gar gtad sa der 'gag /pha rol rnams kyi rkyen gyis kyang*/ /'di la bsgyur du ga la nus/ /bag med shes pa bde yangs pa/ /'di nyid skyes pa'i mi de ni/ /dran pa 'gag med shes rab zin/ /so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab tshad/ /kun gzhi dang ni chos sku yang*/ /'di ltar phyi btags 'di lta bu/ /lus la zhen pa'i blo bral nas/ /rig pa gar gtad sar gnas te/ / lus ni bems po bzhin du 'gyur/ /sems dang ye shes phyed pa ni/ /'gyu byed rnams kyi sgo yang 'gag /'byung ba dngas snyigs sus phyed pa/ /rags pa'i snang ba rang 'gags te/ /lu gu rgyud la bde bar spyod/ /de bzhin 'khor 'das sus phyed pa/ /'khrul pa'i blo rnams skye mi srid/ /gal te skyes kyang phan gnod bral/ /de la sogs pa'i rang shes kyis/ /'khor 'das gtan la phebs pa ni/ /so sor rtog pa'i shes rab bo/ /'jug byed rnam gsum shes rab tshad/ /chos kun tshig gcig smos pa na/ /de yi gzhung kun shes par

ni/ /thos pa'i shes rab tshad du phyin/ /shes pas gang la bsam pa yi/ / bzung de rgyud la bde shar nas/ /bsam pa yang ni de bzhin 'byongs/ /gang byung rkyen gyis mi gnod par/ /'khrul rtog zhen pa rang 'gags nas/ /'dis ni bsgom pa'i shes rab rnyed/ /ces so/ /dper na snang bar byed pas sgron me dang 'dra la/ mched cing spro thub pas spra ba la me stag mched pa lta bu ste/ mu tig phreng ba las/ dper na sreg byed sgron me ltar/ /shes pas chos rnams cig car rtogs/ /zhes pa dang*/ sgron ma 'bar ba las/ dper na spra ba rlan med la/ /me stag phra ba nyid phrad kyang*/ /phra ba kun mched mes bsregs bzhin/ /shes rab kyis ni bag chags bsreg /'di kun shes rab sgron ma'o/ /zhes so/ /de yang gong du shes rab kyi rang rtsal me stag lta bu dang 'brel ba bsgrubs pa'i don te/ de ltar sgron ma bzhi'i gnad 'di gal po che'o/ /tshig don rin po che'i mdzod las ye shes kyi sgo'i gnad bstan pa'i rim pa ste rdo rje'i gnas drug pa'i rgya cher bshad pa'o// // de nas gang la 'char ba yul gyi gnad bstan pa la gsum ste/ yul gyi gnad spyir bstan pa/ sgron ma'i gnad bye brag tu bshad pa/ dbyings rig gi gnas (1) gtan la dbab pa'o/ /dang po ni phyi'i yul nam mkha' stong pa dang*/ nang gi yul dbyings rnam par dag pa'i sgron ma gnyis ni/ rig pa lu gu rgyud 'char ba'i yul du gsal te/ thal 'gyur las/ dbyings ni phyi dang nang du ste/ /phyi ni sprin bral mkha' la 'dzin/ /nang dbyings sgron ma lam du'o/ /zhes so/ /phyi'i yul nam mkha' stong pa la rig pa gtad pas de dang mtshungs pa'i nyams stong gsal rnam dag tu 'char ba'i phyir nam mkha' bshad de/ de nyid las/ 'di nyid yul gnad 'di lta ste/ /sprin bral phyi yul stong pa la/ /rnal 'byor nam mkha'i bya lam gnas/ /'di dang ma bral chos nyid do/ /zhes pa dang*/ sdud pa las/

don de gang yin nam mkha' dag la blta bar gyis/ / zhes pa dang*/ yum bar ma las/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa sgom par 'dod pas nam mkha' rnal 'byor du bya'o zhes pa dang*/ nam mkha' che las/ rnal 'byor nam mkha'i bya lam gnas/ /nam mkha' stong pa skye med cing*/ /skye med de ni nam mkha' bzhin/ /zhes pa dang*/ thal 'gyur las/ yul la snang ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ /nam mkha' sngo bsangs rdzi med la/ /'od dang kha dog dbyings nyid dang*/ /ye shes lnga yi rang snang gsal/ /zhes so/ /de ltar phyi'i nam mkha' la nang dbyings snang ba ni snang ba dang stong pa gnyis su med pa'i dbyings zhes bya ste/ snga ma las/ phyi dang nang kun chos kyi dbyings/ /rnam par dag pa'i spyod yul la/ /sangs rgyas sems can gnyis med de/ /las kyis bcos su ga la yod/ /ces so/ /de ltar yul nam mkha' stong pa dbyings snang*/ dbyings kyi ra bar rig pa lu gu rgyud 'gul 'phrig med par bzhag nas blta ba ni/ rdzogs pa chen po 'di'i lugs kyi gtad so'i 'ben mngon sum rang ngo la blta ba dbyings rig gnyis su med pa'i dgongs pa zhes bya bar 'dod de/ yi ge med pa las/ skye ba med pa'i mngon sum sangs rgyas kyis/ /yul med rnam par dag pa'i nam mkha' mthong*/ /zhes so/ /thabs gang gis mthong na lta stangs dang gzigs stangs shes pas mthong ba ste 'og tu 'chad do/ / don gnyis pa sgron ma'i gnad la gsum ste/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ /dang po ni/ spyir 'khor ba'i bya ba spangs la dben par gnas pa/ bye brag tu zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar la phyi'i bya ba thams cad spang nas mtshams dam par bcad de bla ma dang mkha' 'gro mchod nas rgya mtsho ar gtad kyi mun khrid la 'jug pas/ sgom khang mun pas brgyan par gcig pur mi g.yo ba gsum gyis gnas pa ste/ thal 'gyur las/ sgron ma ltems pa 'di lta ste/ /dad ldan 'khor ba'i yid bral bas/ /bla ma mchod dang gtor ma

bya/ /'khor ba'i 'brel ba kun spangs la/ /dben pa'i phyogs sam dur khrod du/ /grogs spangs gcig pur gnas par bya/ /zhes so/ / dngos gzhi la rtsol med dang*/ rtsol bcas gnyis rtsol med la'ang rang gdangs nam mkha'i rnal 'byor dang*/ rang gnad rgya mtsho'i rnal 'byor gnyis las/ dang po ni lta stangs dang gzigs stangs gsum bstun te smin mtshams nas sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad kyi nam mkha' la mig mi 'gul sems ma yengs rlung rab tu dal ba gsum gnad du bstun pa ste/ sgron ma snang byed las/ mtshan dus rang gi gnas khang du/ /nyin mo bzhin du rtag tu blta/ /zhes so/ /de la dang po du ba lta bu dang*/ sprin dkar po lang long lta bu dang*/ smig rgyu lta bu dang*/ skar ma lta bu dang*/ me stag lta bu dang*/ mar me lta bu dang*/ mthing ga khyab pa chen po'i 'od re khā nag po'i rnam pa na ro lta bu mthong ste/ 'od zer dang thig le dang dbyings rig gi stong gzugs tshad med pa 'char ro/ /rgya mtsho'i rnal 'byor ni lta stangs dang gzigs stangs rlung gnad gsum bstun la mtheb mdzub gsum gyis mi bya bar gnyis kyis tsakṣu'i 'bras bu ltems pas dang po dmar ngam pa dang ljang ser dang mthing ga'i snang ba la 'od tser tser yod pa snyam byed pa dang*/ thig le stong pa'i sgron ma dngos dmar ser du 'char dus dar cig bltems la shes pa snang ba der blta ba ma yengs pas mtheb mdzub btang nas rgya mtsho dngas su bcug la blta'o/ /yang snang ba de kun mi gsal bar song dus ltem zhing yang dngas su bcug pas zhag gsum bzhi na ma ltems kyang snang nas de nyid la dngas bcug nas bsgoms pa gcig pus chog go /snang ba ni rtsa bzang ba rnams la 'od dang*/ thig le dang*/ lu gu rgyud dang*/ dbyings snang dpag tu med pa 'char la/ ngan pa rnams la 'phel snang cung zad nyung ste/ don la shes pa stong gsal gyi ngang la bsgoms pas 'char snang mang nyung 'dra'o/

/de dag ni nges pa'i dbyings rig gi snang ba zhes bya'o/ /ma nges pa'i stong gzugs la tshad med do/ /lha'i sku sna tshogs dang*/ 'gro ba drug gi snang ba dang*/ yul thag ring po'i ljongs dang*/ rgya mtsho'i gling dang*/ lha la sogs pa'i yul dang*/ ri mo dang*/ mchod rten dang*/ padma dang*/ 'dre dang*/ ro dang*/ ri bo brtsegs pa la sogs pa brjod kyis mi lang ba 'char ba ni rtsa 'dab ma dag pa rnams su nang gi rlung 'dus pa'i snang ba yin te lta stangs bsgyur bas rang log la 'gro ba yin no/ / gzhan yang 'od rtsa dngas pas phyi rol rgyang ring po dang lus kyi nang zang thal du mthong ba dang*/ sgom khang la zang thal du phyir 'thon pa 'byung ste/ dbu ma'i 'od rtsar rlung zin pa'i gnad las 'byung ba tsam las bzang ngan 'dra ste rlom sems dang 'dzin pa med par bya'o/ /gnad de dag ni thal 'gyur las/ gsum po ltems pa ma yin par/ /rang gi mtheb dang mdzub mo yis/ /thig le stong pa'i sgron ma bltem/ /bltems pa de las gang byung ba/ /chos nyid mngon sum snang ba'o/ /zhes pa dang*/ sgron ma 'bar ba las/ rang gi mtheb dang mdzub mo yis/ /tsakṣu'i phug dang 'gram btsir na/ /mngon du snang de yid ches kyis/ /de ni rtsol med rang grol lo/ /zhes so/ / gnyis pa rtsol bcas kyi gnad ni/ rgyang zhags bltems (1) pa dang 'od rtsa chung du ltems pa gnyis 'jug pa gcig dus gcig la byas pas snang ba 'od gsal du mched pa dang*/ shes pa bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin phebs pa dus mnyam du 'gyur (2) ste/ de las/ rtsol ba can de yang 'di ltar/ /rang gi mjing pa'i phyi rol rtsa/ /'phrig cing 'phar ba drag pa la/ /sor dang mdzub kyis yang btsir nas/ /mig gi 'dug stangs mkhas pas bca'/ /'od ni mda' gang tshun chad gsal/ /de la mched pa'i dus rnams bzung*/ /'di yi thabs kyi man ngag tu/ /'di kun de yi der 'gyur ro/ /zhes so/ / gsum pa rjes snang ba'i 'char tshul la snang ba dang por mthong ba'i nyams dang*/

gong du mched pa rdzogs pa'i nyams gnyis las/ dang po ni thal 'gyur las/ de ltar bltems pa'i snang ba ni/ /dang po dmar po dag pa yis/ /dbang rdzogs zlum po rang gsal rdzogs/ /mdzub gnyis dag las gsum du 'gyur/ /de nas yang yang bltems pa yis/ /ye shes lnga yi kha dog ni/ /dkar dmar ljang gu mthing ser gyi/ /yul la snang ste rtsol ba'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa la mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni thal 'gyur las/ de la ye shes 'phel ba'i nyams/ /kha dog dang ni dbyibs kyi yang*/ /phyi dang nang kun gsal bar khyab/ /gong nas gong du nges par 'phel/ /'di dus lus ngag bde ba'i rtags/ /snang ba'i tshad dang rim pas sbyar/ /ye shes rdzogs pa'i snang ba dang*/ /chos nyid dag pa'i snang ba las/ /snang gsum rdzogs nas zad par 'gyur/ /de la 'bras bu zhes bya'o/ /zhes so/ / gnyis pa ni/ sgron ma 'bar ba las/ goms pa yi ni gnad kyis ni/ /dmar po'i shas med lnga ldan par/ /gyur te nam mkha' snang ba'i mi/ / 'dis ni rig pa'i rang dbang thob/ /ces pa dang*/ thal 'gyur las/ de nas rtsol bral phyir snang ste/ /rlung gi cha yi 'gro 'ong dang*/ /me long dag gi dbyibs tsam yang*/ /gnyis dang gsum gyi char snang ngo*/ /de nyid rtag tu goms pa las/ /kha dog lnga yi 'od kyi yang*/ /re lde tsam las gru chad snang*/ / yul gru tsam las mthong tshad do/ /de la goms pa'i tshad rnyed nas/ /thig le'i nang du sku dang bcas/ /phyed sku dag tu yun 'ga' gnas/ /de las lnga lnga zung du bcas/ /rab tu gsal ba'i thig les 'brel/ /yab yum sku yi snang ba can/ /'khrul snang zad nas zhing khams so/ /'di dus lus ngag yid kyi tshad/ /so so'i snang ba mthong dus kyi/ /rang la smin pas rtags rdzogs te/ / zad pa'i tshad rnams mngon par snang*/ /'di la brtson 'grus che chung gis/ / zhag dang zla ba lo rnams kyis/ /so so'i dus la nges par 'grub/ /'gyur ba med pa'i dus dag la/

/so so'i tshad la phebs pa'o/ /zhes so/ /de yang brtson 'grus rab rnams nyams su len pa dngos gzhi la zhugs nas le lo med par nyin mtshan du bsgoms na rab lo gsum dang zla ba gcig 'bring rnams lo bzhi dang zla ba lnga zhag drug tha ma rnams lo bdun dang zla ba bcu bzhi la chos nyid ka dag gi sa la de bzhin gshegs par rtags tshad kyi yi ge las gsungs so/ / spyi don gsum pa dbyings rig gi gnad gtan la dbab pa la gsum ste/ dbyings rig gi rnam par gzhag pa spyir bstan/ nyams su len tshul bye brag tu bshad/ gnad gsum nges pas don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ ngo bo spyir bstan/ rnam dbye bye brag tu bshad/ rtogs par gdams tshul bstan pa'o/ /dang po la'ang ngo bo dngos dang*/ khyad par bstan pa gnyis/ ngo bo la gnyis las/ dbyings kyi ngo bo mthing ga las kha dog lngar mched pa'i 'od gdangs yin la/ rig pa'i ngo bo dngos nang na yod kyang gdangs phyir gsal bas rig pa zhes btags te lu gu rgyud du snang ba ni/ mu tig phreng ba las/ dper na gser gyi lu gu rgyud/ /bzo bo mkhas pas brgyus pa ltar/ / rig pas thams cad shes shing rig /rtog med 'khor bas gos pa med/ /lu gu rgyud ni 'brel chags so/ /zhes pa dang*/ seng ge rtsal rdzogs las/ rig pa'i ye shes sgron ma ni/ /sems can kun la rang chas te/ /rnam pa gnyis kyi tshul du 'char/ /thig le stong pa'i sgron ma dang*/ /rig pa dbyings kyi sgron ma'o/ /'du 'bral med pa'i tshul du 'char/ /zhes so/ /khyad par bstan pa la/ brten pa/ mtshan nyid/ gnas/ dus/ rtogs pa dang lnga las/ rten dngos ni tsitta na gzhi 'dzin pa'i rig pa la brten pa ni mar me'i 'od mar me la brten pa ltar rig pa dngos kyi 'od khyim dang gdangs su gnas te/ nor bu 'phra bkod las/ rang gi tsitta'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /thig le nyag gcig rang rdzogs na/ /ye nas gnas pa'i rdzogs chen don/

/gsang don rdzogs pa rig pa'i klong*/ /thig le stong pa'i sgron ma dang*/ /rang byung dbyings kyi sgron ma gnyis/ /stong dang mi stong mtha' las 'das/ /rtsol ba med par mngon gnas pa'i/ /snang ba rdzogs phyir rang gnas pa/ /zhes pa dang*/ dbyings dang rig pas rab brgyan te/ /lhun rdzogs thig le chen por gnas/ /zhes so/ /mtshan nyid la gnyis las/ dbyings des rig pa'i rang yul byed pa'i 'od gdangs don dam gyi 'byung lngar gnas shing rig pa de rlung gi 'gro 'ong du yod pa dbyings kyi ra bar gtod pa po'i rang bzhin te/ seng ge rtsal rdzogs las/ rig pa'i mtshan nyid 'di lta ste/ /phra ba nyid dang 'phro ba dang*/ /lu gu rgyud dang 'gul ba'o/ /dbyings kyi mtshan nyid 'di lta ste/ /yangs dang lhun stug stong mtha' yas/ /gsal dang dro dang bsil ba dang*/ /yang zhing g.yo ba'i bdag nyid 'dzin/ /khyab dang mu khyud ra ba'o/ /zhes so/ /dbyings snang ni ye shes lnga'i rang gdangs yin la de'i mtshan nyid ni/ yang de las/ ye shes mtshan nyid 'di lta ste/ /'byung dang byung dang rang gsal dang*/ /ye dang shes dang rtogs pa'o/ /gsal dang 'tsher dang 'byams yas nyid/ /ces so/ /lu gu rgyud las sku'i snang ba grangs med pa 'char la/ de'i mtshan nyid kyang rtsal rdzogs las/ sku yi mtshan nyid 'di lta ste/ /'gyur ba med dang gsal ba dang*/ /stong pa dang ni rtog bral lo/ /zhes so/ /gnas ni mig gnyis te/ mig zur nyid nas dbyings 'byung bas/ /zhes pas so/ /dus ni rnal 'byor pa rnams la tshe 'dir 'char la/ sems can kun la bar dor 'char ro/ / rtogs pa ni chos nyid pa la chos nyid kyi gsal snang du rtogs la/ sems can la mthong yul tsam du rtogs pa'i ming brjod de/ seng ge rtsal rdzogs las/ sems can kun gyi snang ba bshad/ /snang ba de nyid 'di lta ste/ /gnas dang dus dang rtogs pa'o/ /gnas ni bri gu ta na gnas/ /dus ni bar ma do na 'char/

/nam mkha' dbyings kyi sgron mar rtaugs/ /de yang mthong ba'i dus su bstan/ /zhes so/ / gnyis pa rnam dbye bye brag tu bshad pa la/ gzhi/ lam/ 'bras bu'i dbyings rig gsum las/ gzhi'i dbyings rig la'ang bya ba rdzogs pa'i gzhi rig pa ka dag gi snang ba yin la/ rtogs byed thabs kyi gzhi ni de'i snang ba nang dbyings da lta snying ga na 'od gdangs su gsal ba'o/ /lam gyi dbyings rig ni mngon sum yul la shar dus 'od kyi mu khyud ni dbyings la/ rdo rje lu gu rgyud sku lnga'i thig les 'brel ba rig pa'o/ /'bras bu la'ang dbyings 'od lnga'i zhing snang nam mkha' khyab par snang ste/ rig pa shes rab kyi rtog pas skur smin te zhi khro'i tshom bu dang dkyil 'khor du gsal ba rnams so/ /de ltar na dbyings ra ba ye shes kha dog rig pa sku rnams 'du 'bral med pa ni dbyings rig 'du 'bral med pa'i ye shes zhes bya'o/ /de yang dbyings kyi kha dog gi cha la ye shes kyi snang ba zer yang dbyings kyi bre brag yin no/ /seng ge rtsal rdzogs las/ de yang dbyings dang rig pa bshad/ /de yi bshad lugs 'di lta ste/ /gzhi la gnas pa'i dbyings rig dang*/ /lam la snang ba'i dbyings rig dang*/ /mtha' la skyol ba'i dbyings rig go

/gzhi yi dbyings rig rnam gnyis ni/ /rtogs byed thabs kyi gzhi dang ni/ /bya ba rdzogs pa'i gzhi ru bshad/ /rtogs byed thabs kyi gzhi yi dus/ /bag chags phung po 'di la bshad/ /bya ba rdzogs pa'i gzhi gnas ni/ /chos nyid ka dag snang bar bshad/ /rtogs byed thabs kyi gzhi bshad pa/ /dbyings ni dbyings kyi sgron ma la/ /rig pa lu gu rgyud du gsal/ /lam la snang ba'i dbyings rig ni/ /dbyings ni 'od kyi mu khyud la/ /rig pa sku lnga'i snang bar bshad/ /mtha' la skyol ba'i dbyings rig ni/ /dbyings ni rang bzhin snang ba la/ /rig pa sku dang ngo bor bstan/ /de phyir dbyings dang rig pa bshad/ /de bzhin nyid du rab tu gnas/ /dbyings dang rig pa ye shes gsum/ /'du 'bral med pa'i tshul du gnas/ /zhes so/ / gsum pa rtogs par gdams pa la gsum ste/ ma rtogs pa'i skyon la bsams nas rtogs dgos par bstan pa 'dir chos thams cad bstan pas rtogs dgos par bstan pa/ nyams su len dgos pas rtogs par bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rin chen spungs pa'i rgyud las/ dbyings rig gnyis med ma shes par/ /mi rtog ltengs po sus bsgoms pa/ /ri bo rked par gcod dang 'dra/ /zhes pas ngal ba don med par bstan to/ /gnyis pa ni/ rtsal rdzogs las/ dbyings dang rig pa'i don nyid ni/ /lta sgom spyod pa kun gyi dngos/ / ye shes rang snang gzung 'dzin bral/ /dbyings dang rig pa nyid kyi don/ /'di yi ngang du thams cad 'dus/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ rig pa'i ngo bo chos sku dri med ka dag yin pas lta sgom nyams len las 'das pa yin kyang byang na g.yag yod du song bas nyams su ma blangs na phan med/ rdos bcas kyi lus dang 'khrul rtog gi sems dag la dbyings rig gi man ngag gnad du bsnun dgos pas na dbyings rig shes dgos te/ yi ge med pa las/ e ma dngos po med pa'i snang ba ngo mtshar che ba ste rags pa'i 'byung ba lngas bsgribs pas lus med pa la snang ba ma nus so/

/rig pa rang snang gi ngo bo lhun brjid de phra ba'i nyon mongs pas bsgribs pas rtag ma thub pa'o/ /chos nyid la bkod pa'i snang ba gsal dngas te sna tshogs du ma'i spyod pas bsgribs nas mngon sum du med do/ /de yang rig pa'i ngo bo bzung bar dka' yang ye shes kyi rtsal dal bas 'grub/ rig pa'i dbyings mi 'gyur bar gnas kyang ṛg pa'i stobs rkyen zad pas 'grub/ rig pa'i rang bzhin kun la khyab kyang chos kyi sku gdams ngag la thug go zhes gsungs so/ / gnyis pa nyams su len tshul bye brag tu bshad pa la gnyis te/ dbyings rig 'brel pa'i gnad spyir bstan pa dang*/ so so'i gnad bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la thabs kyis rang ngo sprad pa/ de'i ngang la bskyang ba/ grol tshad nges pa'i 'bras bu dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ thal 'gyur las/ de la spyi yi mthong ba ni/ /goms dang gnad kyis mthong ba ste/ /goms pa sngon du 'gro bas na/ /brtsams te lus ngag gnad gzir bas/ /rang snang dag pa'i gzugs mthong nas/ /'khrul pa thams cad nub pa'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa la/ lta ba'i ngo bo ngos gzung*/ sgom pa'i ngang la rang babs su bskyang*/ spyod pa 'bral med du spyad pa dang gsum las/ lta ba ni dbyings snang 'od dang rig snang lu gu rgyud de/ de nyid las/ 'od dang kha dog dbyibs nyid dang*/ /ye shes lnga yi rang snang ston/ /zhes so/ /sgom pa ni/ klong drug pa las/ dbyings gnyis su snang ba'i dus na dbyings dang rig pa tshad la dbab pa dang*/ snang ba thams cad ci yang ma yin par chos nyid zad pa'i mtha' la mkhas par bya'o zhes pa dang*/ rang gsal blo la goms pa yis/ /nang gsal 'gyu yid phyir mi 'chor/ /dngos po'i rjes su sems mi 'brang*/ /zhes so/ /spyod pa ni/ thal 'gyur las/ spyod pa'i sbyangs sa dbyings rig la/ /gzer gsum ldan pas 'bral med par/ /rtag tu 'dris nas spyod pa ste/ /chos kun bya ba bral ba dang*/

/'khor 'das 'brel pa chad pa'i dus/ /rtog bcas 'khrul pa 'gags pa ste/ /'khor ba'i g.yang sa rgyun chad pas/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i spyod pa'o/ /zhes so/ /rang gnad ni de nyid las/ rig pa'i gnad ni dbyung ba dang*/ /bskyil zhing mkha' la gtod pa'o/ /dbyings kyi gnad ni bsdu ba dang*/ /dgug dang khams kyi dbye bas sbyar/ /zhes so/ / gsum pa grol tshad nges pa'i 'bras bu ni/ gnas skabs snang la 'phel bas rig pa skur smin pa dang*/ mthar thug zad pa la spyod pas snang dbyings ka dag la rig pas rang sa zin pas mtha' la skyol ba ste/ thal 'gyur las/ dag pa dbyings kyi sgron ma la/ /thig le sku dang 'khrul snang dag /rang bzhin nyid dang ngo bo nyid/ /gnyis med 'du 'bral med par snang*/ /'di dus zad pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /bya bral nam mkha' ji bzhin no/ /zhes pa dang*/ 'bras bu brjod par mi nus kyang*/ /chos rnams zad sar phyin pa dang*/ /rang gi grub pa'i mtha' yang 'jig /'di dus bla ma'i man ngag nub/ /lta sgom spyod pa'i mtha' stongs pas/ /chos su snang ba yod ma yin/ /sku dang ye shes rgyun chad pas/ /sangs rgyas med cing sems can med/ /mdor na gang yang gnas pa med/ /song ba med pas 'ong med pa'o/ /zhes so/ / gnyis pa so so'i gnad la gnyis las/ dang po dbyings kyi gnad ni/ sgron ma snang byed las/ dbyings kyi gnad ni tsitta ste/ /nam mkha'i khams ni snying la gnas/ /dbyings kyi lam ni rlung yin pas/ /shes pa'i dngas ma 'od du gsal/ /dbyings kyi sgo ni mdzod spu bas/ /mthing ga khyab chen shes pa'i grogs/ /dbyings kyi yul ni mig yin pas/ /mthong byed zur la rgyun du gnas/ /dbyings kyi zad pa nam mkha' ste/ /ris med yul la khyab par gdal/ /dbyings kyi 'bras bu lus yin pas/ /mthong byed 'khrul snang 'di gcod (1) do/ /dbyings kyi gol sa 'od yin pas/ /gser sgrog thag sgrog 'ching bar mnyam/ /dbyings kyi sgrog ni 'byung ba lnga/

/zad pas 'khrul pa'i zhen yul 'gag /de phyir yon tan thams cad ni/ /dbyings dang rig pa phungs pas dpungs/ /zhes so/ /rig pa'i gnas ni dung yig can las/ rig pa'i gnas ni snying yin pas/ /chos kyi sku yang snying gar gnas/ /rig pa'i lam ni rtsa yin pas/ /thig le nyag gcig rtsa nas 'gyu/ /rig pa'i sgo ni mig yin pas/ /lta ba khyab chen mig nas 'char/ /rig pa'i yul ni mkha' yin pas/ /gzung dka' khyab gdal nam mkhar zin/ /rig pa'i rdos ni 'khor ba ste/ /nyag gcig cha phra kun tu khyab/ /rig pa'i grogs ni myang 'das te/ /gnad gzir rig ngo stong gsal mthong*/ /rig pa'i gol sa sku gsum ste/ /zhen 'dod mthar ni lhung bar 'gyur/ /rig pa'i sgrib pa lta sgom ste/ / byas pa rnams ni 'jig pa'i rgyu/ /rig pa'i 'khrul sa 'od yin te/ /gzhan 'byung 'khrul pa'i rtsa ba can/ /zhes so/ /de yang sku gsum lam snang du 'char ba la 'bras bur zhen nas dga' brod du song bas lhung ba zhig yin no/ /rig pa ka dag zang ma 'di rjen par ngos ma zin na lta sgom thams cad yid dpyod sems kyi sgrib par song bas gnyen po dug tu song ba bshal sman brdzings pa lta bu zhig yin no/ /'od la zhen pa a 'thas na sa rdo la zhen pa dang 'dra ste/ dang po yang 'od la bzung bas 'khrul pa'i phyir 'di yang gol sa cig yin no/ /gnad 'di kun shin tu gal che bar yod pas rtogs par bya'o/ / gsum pa gnad gsum nges pas don bsdu ba la gnyis te/ gnad ma shes na skyon yod pas shes par gdams pa dang gnad dngos so/ /dang po ni sgron ma snang byed las/ lus kyi gnad nyid ma shes na/ /dkor mdzod sgo mo dam dgrigs ltar/ /phyi nas nor rnyed ma yin no/ /bskyed pa yi ni rim pa yi/ /don nyid dang ni khyad med ltar/ /dbyings kyi gnad nyid mi shes na/ /bya lam nam mkha'i mtha' tshol 'dra/ /rig pa'i gnad de ma shes na/ /nam mkha' spar gyis 'debs dang 'dra/

/gnad gsum man ngag ma shes par/ / bsgom par 'dod pa'i sgom chen de/ /spyad dbang med pa'i nor bsrung 'dra/ / de phyir gnad gsum 'brel pa gces/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ rig pa'i ye shes lus la gnas pas dang po lus gnad 'dug stangs las mi 'da' ba gces/ yul gyi gnad nam mkha' yin pas mdzod spu'i nam mkha' las mi 'gyur bar blta ba gces/ rig pa'i gnad lu gu rgyud dbyings kyi ra bar bcug nas mi 'gul bar 'jog pa la mig mi 'gul zhing rlung rab tu dal ba gces pa ste/ dung yig can las/ rig pa rten sa lus yin te/ /lus shig med na med pa ste/ /yod na ye shes yod par nges/ /de ltar lus la yod pa de/ /chos can spyi yi mtshan nyid kyis/ /spyi bo'i gtsug nas rkang mthil bar/ /brtag dpyad rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /dpyad pas de nyid rnyed pa min/ /mo dang pra la sogs pa yi/ /rtsis ni rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /bltas shing dpyad kyang rnyed pa min/ /'o na gtan med yin zhe na/ /gtan du med pa ma yin te/ /lus ngag ltems na mngon du snang*/ /dper na lus la khrag khyab ste/ /skyes bu glen pa 'ga' zhig gis/ /gang gang lus la khrag btsal bas/ / gcig kyang 'byung ba ma yin no/ /'o na lus la khrag med dam/ /lus la med pa ma yin te/ /thams cad khyab cing khrag la brten/ /skyes bu thabs dang ldan pa yis/ /rtsa la gtar na khrag 'byung ltar/ /lus gnad ye shes de bzhin no/ /yul gyi gnad ni nam mkha' ste/ /'di nyid mi shes kha cig gis/ /nyin dang mtshan mo med pa ru/ /nam mkha' nyid la blta byas kyang*/ /'di nyid mthong ba ma yin no/ /gtan du med pa ma yin te/ /'di nyid goms pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /skad cig nyid la don shes 'gyur/ /rig pa'i gnad ni nyin mtshan du/ /rtag tu de nyid la gnas bya/ /gzhan pa'i sems kyis skad cig kyang*/ /yengs shing 'bral bar mi bya'o/ /'o na gnad gsum ye shes de/

/ 'di nyid ma gtogs gzhan rnams kyis/ /mthong ba dag ni med dam ci/ / gzhan lta spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /'di nyid ma bstan bar du ni/ /ji ltar brtags kyang mthong ba min/ /dam pa'i gdams ngag 'di bstan na/ /ba rnams lus la 'o mas khyab/ /mkhas pas nu ma nas 'then na/ /'o ma dag ni 'byung ba bzhin/ /mngon du gsal te lus gnad kyis/ /rtag tu goms dang khyad med mthong*/ /bshan pa smad 'tshong sdig can la/ /'di nyid bstan pas grol thob 'gyur/ /nyan thos rang sangs rgyas rnams dang*/ /byang sems sgrib pa bral bas kyang*/ /'di nyid gnad gsum gdeng med na/ /rdul phran tsam yang mthong mi 'gyur/ /gzhan dag gis ni smos ci dgos/ /des na goms dang thabs nyid gces/ /zhes so/ /tshig don rin po che'i mdzod las yul gyi gnad bstan pa ste rdo rje'i gnas bdun pa rgya cher bshad pa'o// // de nas yang dag pa'i ye shes nyams su blang ba'i thabs bstan pa la gsum ste/ gang gis nyams su blang ba gang zag gi rim pa/ ji ltar smin pa dbang gi rim pa/ yongs su grol byed gdams pa'i rim pa'o/ /dang po la'ang gsum ste/ ston byed bla ma'i rang bzhin/ bstan bya slob ma'i rang bzhin/ thun mong du bsten tshul nges pa'o/ /dang po la blang dor gnyis las/ yang dag pa'i bla ma la brten par gdams pa las de'i mtshan nyid ngos gzung ba ni/ spyir theg pa mtha' dag gi gnas la mkhas shing thugs rje'i rlabs che ba/ gsang sngags kyi don la mkhas shing dbang gi chu bo rdzogs pa/ dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas shing bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi la rtags thon pa/ bye brag tu rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i don la dbang 'byor bas gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa la dbang ba ste/ de yang rtogs shing lta ba la mkhas pas chos nyid mngon sum gyi drod tshad thob pa/ goms shing sgom pa la mkhas pas rtag tu chos nyid las mi 'da' ba/ gnyis med spyod pa la mkhas pas gzung 'dzin dang rnam rtog bags kyis chung zhing blang dor med pa/

mthar phyin 'bras bu la mkhas pas grol tshad gsum gang rung yod cing re dogs dang 'bad rtsol zhig pas khong yangs shing blo bde ba ste/ thal 'gyur las/ mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i bla ma ni/ /yon tan kun gyi 'byung khungs bzhin/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub gzhi 'dzin pa'o/ /zhes pa dang*/ rang shar las/ rdo rje'i don ldan slob dpon ni/ / ngang rgyud bzang zhing slob la mkhas/ /dbang thob gsang sngags don la sbyor/ / phyi nang bya ba thams cad shes/ /yi dam lha dang 'du 'bral med/ /ting nge 'dzin las yeng ba med/ /rdzogs chen man ngag don ldan pa'i/ /gsang sngags gsang ba'i rgyud la mkhas/ /phyi nang bya ba thams cad byed/ /lta ba'i don las mi 'da' zhing*/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i bya ba btang*/ /yon tan nor bu rin chen ltar/ /zad med gter la spyod pa'o/ /zhes pa dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa' snying gi me long las/ yangs shing rgyud dang grub mtha' dag la mkhas/ /ngang rgyud bzang zhing rtogs pa'i lta ba mkhas/ /gsang sngags rgyal po rdo rje ā li kā/ /zhes so/ /dbye na rang shar las/ slob dpon la yang don bzhi ste/ /spyi dang 'dren dang dam tshig dbang*/ /man ngag lung gi slob dpon no/ /zhes bzhir bshad kyang skabs 'dir gnyis su bsdu ste/ thal 'gyur las/ rtsa ba yan lag bla ma gnyis/ /zhes pa dang*/ dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ man ngag phog na rtsa ba'i bla ma zhes bya la/ de dag gang rung re'am gnyis ldan lta bu ni yan lag gi bla ma zhes bya'o/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma gnyis yod na'ang da lta de'i man ngag gang la rang spyod pa ste rab tu gnyan pas gzhi ldan zhes bya ba yin no/ / gnyis pa dor bya'i bla ma ni yon tan phun sum tshogs pa de dag dang mi ldan zhing sdom pa dang dam tshig 'chal ba/ mi shes la nga rgyal che ba/ tshe 'di'i bya ba dang so tshigs slob cing rang gi sar bcings nas slob ma blo gros kyi mig zum thar ba'i lam stor bar byed pa ste/ rang shar las/ mi shes nga rgyal chen po dang*/

/blun rmongs tshig phyir 'breng ba dang*/ /gsang sngags don la mi dgongs dang*/ /gzhan gyi zhe gcod khengs tshig dang*/ /log pa'i lam du zhugs pa dang*/ /dbang gi dkyil 'khor zhal ma mthong*/ /dam tshig 'chal bar gyur pa dang*/ /dris pa dag la lan mi thebs/ /thos chung nga rgyal che ba ste/ /slob dpon ma brtags slob ma'i bdud/ /gsang sngags ston pa'i slob dpon min/ /rdzogs chen a ti ston mi nus/ /de dang 'grogs par mi bya'o/ / zhes pa dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa' snying gi me long las/ slob dpon tshad mar ma gyur spre'u 'dra'i lung*/ /log pa'i lam zhugs gsang sngags 'chol bar spyod/ /de ni log 'dren yin pas spang bar bya/ /zhes so/ / gnyis pa slob ma'i mtshan nyid la gnyis te/ thun mong gi snod spyir bstan pa dang*/ khyad par gyi snod bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la blang dor gnyis las/ dbang dang gdams pa thun mong pa'i gnas ston pa'i snod bzang po ni/ rang shar las/ dad pa'i stobs dang brtson 'grus che/ /shes rab che zhing 'dzin chags med/ /phu dud che zhing gsang sngags spyod/ /rtog med sems la g.yeng ba med/ /dam tshig ldan zhing sgrub la brtson/ /breng nge dung nge brtse gdung can/ /lhang nge lhan ne sgom la spyod/ /slob dpon gsung pa ji bzhin spyod/ /dam tshig 'chal bar mi gtong zhing*/ /spyod lam gzhan dang mthun par spyod/ /gus pa'i tshul gyis sems gdung zhing*/ /tshig gcig bstan pa'ang rjes su 'dzin/ /rang gi don la de bzhin spyod/ /gsang ba gnyer gtad thub par byed/ /rdo rje'i don las mi 'da' zhing*/ /thos pa che ba'i gang zag

bsten/ /rang gi don las 'da' ba med/ /dregs pa'i tshig med 'jam por smra/ /pha rol sems dang mthun par 'jug /slob dpon dang ni de bzhin gshegs/ /khyad med gcig gi tshul du byed/ /de ni slob ma'i mtshan nyid de/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i snod du gsungs/ /zhes pa dang*/ thal 'gyur las/ dad dang shes rab ldan pa dang*/ /mos shing 'khrul nor med pa dang*/ /brjod bya rnams la 'khrul nor med/ /dbang po gsal bas bla ma bsten/ /zhes pa dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa' snying gi me long las/ nga rgyal dregs med ngang gis shes pa dal/ /bka' drin mi gsod gsang sngags don la sbyor/ /nges par dad ldan gtong phod phun sum tshogs/ /rdo rje'i don ldan gsang sngags snod du gsungs/ /zhes so/ /dor bya'i slob ma ni/ rang shar las/ bkur sti phu dud mi byed cing*/ /gsang sngags 'chol bar spyod pa dang*/ /rigs rgyud med cing ngang rgyud med/ /shes rab chung bar gyur pa dang*/ /bka' drin khyad du gsod pa dang*/ /rang gi rigs rgyud brjod pa dang*/ /lus la rgyan bzang 'dogs pa dang*/ /don med 'chal bar gyur pa ste/ /slob ma ma brtags slob dpon dgra/ /nyams su mi len gang zag la/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i don mi bshad/ / ces pa dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa' snying gi me long las/ mi shes nga rgyal che zhing blun rmongs gcam bu can/ /nga rgyal dregs tshig smra zhing mched la ras chod byed/ /ngo tsha med cing khrel med bag 'dzem med/ /gsang sngags snod min gang zag spang bar bya/ /zhes so/ / gsum pa thun mong du bsten tshul nges pa la gsum ste/ bsrung rgyu gcig pas phan tshun brtse gdung la gnas pa/ snod brtags nas gsang ba'i don gdams pa/ bla ma bsten tshul phan yon dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po la bsrung rgyu gcig pa dang*/ brtse gdung bskyed pa gnyis las/ dang po ni gsang sngags kyi dam tshig dpon slob gnyis kas bsrung dgos par gcig pas phan tshun ma gus pa dang rtsod pa la sogs pa spang dgos te/

dam tshig 'doms pa'i ston pa slob dpon yin la snod slob ma yin pa'i phyir te/ rang shar las/ slob dpon dang ni slob ma gnyis/ /bsrung ba'i rgyu zhes kun tu grags/ /bsrung ba'i rgyu ni slob dpon te/ /srung bar byed pa slob ma'o/ /de la spyod pa rjes 'jug go /zhes so/ /des na gcig la gcig brtse gdung bskyed dgos te/ de nyid las/ thugs rje'i 'brel thag ma chad cing*/ /brtse gdung rgyun thag ma chad pa/ /slob dpon slob ma'i 'brel ba'o/ /zhes so/ /slob dpon des thugs rjes gzigs pa dang slob ma des brtse gdung bskyed pa gnyis 'brel ba che shos yin pas de ltar bya'o/ / gnyis pa snod brtag pa ni/ de nyid las/ man ngag rdzogs pa chen po'i don/ /snod ngan phal du blugs mi bya/ /dad dang ldan pa 'ga' yi bcud/ / snod ngan dag tu blugs gyur na/ /bcud med gnyis ka phung bar byed/ /de phyir blo dman rnams la gsang*/ /zhes so/ / gsum pa bla ma bsten tshul phan yon dang bcas pa la bsten tshul dang*/ phan yon gnyis las/ dang po ni/ thal 'gyur las/ rtsa ba yan lag bla ma gnyis/ /so so'i mtshan nyid tshang ba la/ /rgyal srid dang ni rang gi lus/ / 'khor dang longs spyod rnams kyis bsten/ /lus ngag spyod pa mnyes pa yis/ /bla ma sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor bsten/ /zhes pa dang*/ rang shar las/ de ldan man ngag slob dpon la/ /rang lus dang ni rin chen rdzas/ /shin tu dkon pa dag gis bsten/ /zhes pa dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa' snying gi me long las/ gsang sngags rgyal po rdo rje ā li kā/ /lus yon phul la rab tu bsten par bya/ /zhes so/ /phan yon ni thal 'gyur las/ bsten pa de las yon tan ni/ /dpag bsam shing dang yid bzhin nor/ /'dod 'jo'i ba dang 'dra ba yi/ /yon tan dpag tu med pa thob/ /de la dmigs te bla ma bsten/ /'khor ba'i g.yul las bzlog phyir ro/ /zhes so/ / gnyis pa khyad par gyi snod bye brag tu bshad pa la gsum ste/

rdzogs pa chen po bstan pa'i snod spyir bstan pa/ gang gis 'dzin pa'i snod bye brag tu bshad pa/ bstan pa 'dzin pa'i snod bla na med par bsngags pa'o/ /dang po ni/ nor bu 'phra bkod las/ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po ni/ /kun la bstan par mi bya ste/ /gsang ba thub pa 'ga' la bstan/ /gsang sngags gsang ba'i dam pa ni/ /bstan pa'i rigs ni 'di lta ste/ /gsang ba'i gnyer gtad thub par byed/ /gsang ba'i don la 'grus pa dang*/ /shes rab blo rtsal che ba dang*/ /dam tshig sdom pa ldan la bstan/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ thal 'gyur las/ lta ba sgom pa 'dzin pa ni/ /dang po bar dang brtson 'grus dang*/ /gtong bar nus shing bla mar gus/ /brtul zhugs ldan la sdig la 'dzem/ /'gyur med rab tu brtan pos 'dzin/ /yang na ngang ring shugs dal ba/ /lhug pa glen pa'i lhod yod pa/ /rtog pa chung zhing rang bzhin dal/ /lus ngag bya ba bral ba dang*/ /shes rab ldan pas 'dzin par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ / gsum pa ni/ nor bu 'phra bkod las/ rgyal rigs dang ni bram ze'i rigs/ /de bzhin rje'u rigs chen po dang*/ /khyad par chen po'i mi rnams la/ /gsang sngags nges don bstan par gsungs/ /yang na ris med kha dog brtags/ /pho mo gnyis ni gang yang rung*/ /kha dog 'di dang ldan par ni/ / rdzogs pa chen po'i snod du gsungs/ /yan lag rags shing kha dog nag /so nyid thags bzang dkar la 'grig /mig rtsa yid tsam dmar ba dang*/ /skra yi mtshan nyid chen po yang*/ /g.yas su 'khyil zhing kham nag mdog /lus la bkur sti chung ba dang*/ /phyi yi spyod lam tha mal mdog /tshig rnams shugs 'byung smra ba dang*/ /yang na tshig gi rnam pa kun/ /gcig gis gang ltar smras pa ltar/ /skyes bu de yang de ltar smra/ /rdzogs chen gdams ngag bstan par gsungs/ /de rnams gcig la tshang gyur na/ /shan pa'i rigs sam smad 'tshong rigs/ /phyag bdar khrod pa'i rigs kyang rung*/ /rigs ngan gang dag su yin kyang*/

/gsang ba'i man ngag bcud 'di gtad/ /rgyu chung yo byad med pa na/ /rang gis yo byad sbyar nas kyang*/ /lhag ma med par yongs su sbyin/ / gsang ba'i bcud gsum man ngag 'di/ /rigs dang kha dog brtag thabs dang*/ /nga ni mya ngan 'das 'og tu/ /gsang ba'i man ngag yang bcud 'di/ / nges pa'i rgyal po 'di ltar bstan/ /de rnams ldan pa'i skyes bu la/ /gong gi gdams ngag bstan par bya/ /zhes so/ / spyi don gnyis pa smin pa dbang gi rim pa la bzhi ste/ dbang bskur ba'i phan yon/ ma bskur ba'i nyes dmigs/ ji ltar bskur ba'i dbang*/ grogs dam tshig gi rim pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rang shar las/ yon tan bye brag 'di lta ste/ /ye shes snang ba chen po la/ /thogs rdugs med par 'gyur ba dang*/ / rang snang grogs su bsten pa dang*/ /bya ba thams cad byed par 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa' snying gi me long las/ dbang rdzogs sku gsum lhun gyis grub/ /ces pa dang*/dbang mchog thob na gsang sngags ma bsgrubs 'grub/ /ces pa dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ rang shar las/ dbang ma thob pa'i skyon ni 'di lta bu/ bar ma do la bred pa dang*/ dngangs pa dang*/ rdugs pa dang*/ thogs pa dang*/ 'du shes shor ba yang 'byung ngo*/ /bag chags kyi lus ma bor bar du yang 'gro ba rnams kyis bkur ba'i 'os su mi mthong ba dang*/ bsod nams chung ba dang*/ tshe thung ba dang*/ 'tsho ba'i longs spyod nyung ba dang*/ kha nyen pa dang*/ bar chod mang po 'byung ngo*/ /bya ba thams cad mi 'grub bo/ /de ni gsang sngags spyod pa'i dbang ma thob pa'i skyon no zhes pa dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa' snying gi me long las/ dbang mchog ma thob rnal 'byor ni/ / mnyan (1) pa lag skya med pa bzhin/ /pha rol sgrol bar ga la 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa dbang dngos la bzhi ste/ thal 'gyur las/ dbang bskur ba yi cho ga bshad/ /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba dang*/ /yang gsang yongs su rdzogs pa yi/ /sdebs ni rnam pa bzhi dag gis/
